articleTitle: Intelligence Demand-Driven Automatic Path Planning Study for Substation Inspection Robots
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Computer Engineering (ICAICE)
abstract: [Purpose/Significance] The problems of insufficient path planning accuracy and poor environmental adaptability during substation inspection are rooted in the lack of a clear and accurate description of intelligence requirements in complex environments, which leads to insufficient inspection efficiency and safety. This study aims to improve the intelligence level of automatic path planning for substation inspection robots and reduce the risk of power accidents through an intelligence demand-driven approach. [Methods/Process] This study emphasizes the key role of intelligence requirements in the whole process of substation inspection. By identifying the intelligence requirements in the substation environment, the inspection tasks are fine-grained, the substation contingency task module library is constructed, and the intelligence requirement association library for inspection operations and execution subjects is established. Based on this, an automatic route optimization strategy integrating A* algorithm and potential field approach is proposed to form a research framework to effectively respond to inspection tasks under the complex environment of substations. [RESULTS/CONCLUSIONS] The constructed fine-grained task module library and intelligence requirement association library are established before inspection and dynamically updated during inspection. The synergistic effect of these two libraries makes the identification of intelligence requirements in the inspection process faster and more objective, enhances the robot's precision when acquiring environmental information, and enhances the flexibility and reliability of route determination.

articleTitle: Design of SPWM Controller Based on FPGA
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Computer Engineering (ICAICE)
abstract: This study introduces a design methodology for a FPGA-based Sinusoidal Pulse Width Modulation (SPWM) controller, employing the symmetric rule sampling technique. The approach involves multiplying the amplitude of the Sine wave with the period of the triangular carrier wave to derive the high-level modulation duration of the SPWM signal, which subsequently facilitates the generation of the SPWM output. The focus of this paper is on the design methodology and critical considerations for producing the modulation signal utilizing CORDIC Intellectual Property (IP). Ultimately, a controllable quantization error SPWM controller, characterized by the absence of cumulative error, is successfully implemented on an FPGA platform.

articleTitle: Probability-Selected Demonstrations for Enhanced Zero-Shot in-Context Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Computer Engineering (ICAICE)
abstract: With the significant progress of Large Language Models (LLMs) in the domain of Natural Language Processing (NLP), their capacity for In-Context Learning (ICL) has especially drawn attention. These models can learn new tasks directly from a small set of examples, eliminating the need for further training. However, current approaches rely heavily on extensive external resources to create illustrative examples, which proves impractical in many real-world scenarios. To tackle this challenge, this paper introduces a new method for zero-shot In-Context Learning-Probabilistic Selection for In-Context Learning (PS-ICL). PS-ICL generates random samples and selects the most likely correct ones based on the probability of each sample belonging to its correct label. This approach avoids the unpredictability of random selection and exhibits better performance than standard zero-shot learning methods and other zero-shot In-Context Learning techniques.

articleTitle: A Method for Generating Scenarios Based on PC-Crash Accident Data
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Computer Engineering (ICAICE)
abstract: This paper proposes a method for generating OpenSCENARIO1.0 files based on accident data (PCM) exported from PC-CRASH traffic accident reconstruction software. This method analyzes PCM raw data, integrates and processes data from different files such as dynamics data, traffic participant data, and weather data based on simulation time, extracts traffic participants and their motion data based on these data and algorithms, and then combines these data into XOSC files based on XSD(XML Schema Definition) files. Finally, to ensure the accuracy of the generated scenarios, strict validation testing was conducted in the VTD simulation environment.

articleTitle: Gait Prediction Study Under Medical Knee Pads Based on Arctic Puffin Optimization and VMD Decomposition
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Computer Engineering (ICAICE)
abstract: In recent years, various types of knee pads have emerged, and the study of gait data under knee pads has gradually become a research hotspot. However, the prediction research of gait data has been suffering from the dilemma of insufficient accuracy. Based on this, this paper proposes an improved gait data prediction model that combines the bidirectional gated recurrent unit (BiGRU), variational modal decomposition (VMD) and Arctic puffin optimization (APO) algorithms. The experimental results show that the prediction performance of the VMD+APO+BiGRU-based model significantly outperforms that of the pre-improvement model, as well as other classical time series prediction methods. The evaluation metrics of the model on both the training and test sets show extremely high accuracy, especially in the goodness-of-fit R2 up to 0.99853, which validates the effectiveness of the model in gait recognition and disease monitoring under medical knee pads.

articleTitle: A Context-Based Multi-Modal Convolutional BiLSTM Network for Automatic Sleep Staging
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Computer Engineering (ICAICE)
abstract: Sleep staging serves as the foundation for sleep monitoring and quality assessment. This paper proposes an automatic sleep staging model based on contextual learning, utilizing multi-head attention (MHA) mechanism and bidirectional LSTM (BiLSTM) architecture. The model employs a two-pathway convolutional neural network (CNN) structure in parallel to extract features from different modals of EEG and EOG separately. Through feature fusion and contextual learning, it captures the correlations and dependencies between features across modals. Finally, the model leverages the adaptive calibration module analyzing temporal characteristics, to calibrate and refine the learned transition rules for sleep stages. Experimental results demonstrate that our proposed model achieves overall accuracies of 84.1% and 88.3% on the Sleep-EDF-78 and MASS datasets respectively, with F1 scores of 80.1% and 80.5%. Furthermore, its accuracy and robustness surpass those of existing automatic sleep staging.

articleTitle: A General Multi-Scale Time and Channel Spatiotemporal Model for EEG Signal Classification
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Computer Engineering (ICAICE)
abstract: In recent years, with the help of EEG, brain - computer interface (BCI) has played a significant role in brain - related fields. Therefore, indepth analysis of EEG signals has become particularly crucial. The analysis process of EEG signals generally consists of three steps: pre - processing, feature extraction and classification. Regarding EEG signals, we propose a spatiotemporal feature composite classification model with multiple time and channel scales based on convolutional neural networks. Firstly, the model utilizes two-dimensional convolution kernels of different scales to capture time features. Then, it adaptively adjusts the importance of channels and spatial positions through an optimized Convolutional Block Attention Module (CBAM). Next, it extracts spatial features by using depth convolution kernels of different scales. Finally, it employs Bidirectional Long Short-Term Memory (BiLSTM) to conduct indepth processing on the already extracted EEG feature sequences to explore their temporal dependency relationships, and then obtains the classification results through the fully connected layer. Tests across four diverse datasets were conducted, benchmarking our approach against both high-performing deep learning and conventional techniques. The outcomes show our model's superior accuracy and F1 score across the board.

Author Keywords: Multi-scale Time and Channel Spatiotemporal Model(MSTC)

articleTitle: Method for Multi-Hop Question Answering Based on Knowledge Graph with Fusion Path
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Computer Engineering (ICAICE)
abstract: In the context of the big data era, knowledge graphs have become a repository for storing vast amounts of data, and knowledge graph question answering has emerged as a result. However, users are no longer satisfied with simple question-and-answer interactions focused on a single triple; instead, they are demanding more complex multi-hop question-and-answer capabilities. Currently, multi-hop question answering remains a significant challenge. At the same time, if we consider introducing large language models, issues such as poor interpretability and untraceable pathways may arise. To address the above issues, this paper proposes the FP-MHQA (FusionPath Multi-Hop Question Answering) method. Using pre-trained models for knowledge graph and question embedding, and employing GCN to achieve feature fusion of topic entities, knowledge graphs, and questions can guide the model to infer a better next step at each stage, ultimately leading to the correct answer. At the same time, path-based question answering can better achieve path reasoning tracking and has good interpretability. The experimental results indicate that the average accuracy of Hits@1 reaches 99.34% on the 1-hop, 2-hop, and 3-hop datasets of MetaQA, while the accuracy of Hits@1 on the WebQSP dataset is 72.87%. It has been proven that the FP-MHQA method is effective in multi-hop question answering tasks.

articleTitle: The Digital Twin Approach to Fusion Igniter Performance Based on Artificial Intelligence
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Computer Engineering (ICAICE)
abstract: Based on the digital twin method of artificial intelligence fusion ignition device performance, two sets of deep neural networks with similar structure are used, and with the help of the numerical simulation performance model of pulsed-power high-current device established in accordance with the principle of pulsed-power device and the process of magnetohydrodynamics and radiohydrodynamics, it effectively solves the problem of the data-driven model relying solely on the data and ignoring the actual physical process, which leads to the low accuracy and the huge amount of required data. Pain points. Based on the artificial intelligence deep learning method, a new performance digital twin model of pulsed power high current device and fusion ignition is constructed, and key technologies such as artificial intelligence and maximum entropy principle acceleration strategy are adopted to greatly improve the training speed and accuracy of the digital twin. In this paper, by using a digital twin model based on the deep learning method of artificial intelligence, we have successfully solved the problems of low accuracy and huge amount of required data in the performance modelling of fusion ignition device. The model has achieved remarkable results in improving the training speed and accuracy, providing important theoretical guidance and technical support for the performance optimisation and design of fusion ignition devices. Future research can further explore more applications of AI technology in the field of fusion and promote the development and application of fusion technology.

articleTitle: Autonomous Parking Path Planning and Control for Unmanned Vehicles Based on Hybrid A* Algorithm and MPC Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Computer Engineering (ICAICE)
abstract: In recent years, autonomous parking technology has been extensively studied as a core function of unmanned driving. This paper demonstrates the implementation of an autonomous parking feature for unmanned vehicles on an outdoor vehicle platform, using a combination of a Hybrid A* path planning algorithm and a Model Predictive Control (MPC) algorithm. Experimental results show that this approach effectively enhances both path precision and control efficiency in autonomous parking, offering promising market applications and providing an effective solution for realizing autonomous parking technology in unmanned driving.

articleTitle: Research on Feature Extraction and Classification for Unstructured Data Based on Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Computer Engineering (ICAICE)
abstract: With the rapid growth of unstructured data such as text, images, audio, and video, traditional data analysis techniques are facing great challenges in dealing with the complexity and high dimensionality of such data. In this study, we propose a multimodal enhanced Transformer model to process and fuse different types of unstructured data by improving the self-attention mechanism and designing a multi-stream input architecture. Firstly, the model adopts a multi-stream input structure, each stream processes a data modality separately, and maps the data of each modality to the feature space of the same dimension through a dedicated preprocessing and coding network to form a unified representation. Subsequently, a cross-modal self-attention mechanism is introduced into the model, which can establish a global dependency between different modalities and automatically learn the correlation between modal features, so as to extract key features more accurately in the classification process. In order to reduce the computational complexity, an optimization algorithm based on sparse matrix is used to enable the model to efficiently process long sequences and high-dimensional data. Experimental analysis on the benchmark dataset shows that the proposed model is superior to the existing methods in terms of accuracy, precision and recall.

articleTitle: Joint Extraction Model based on Feature Partition and Fusion
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Computer Engineering (ICAICE)
abstract: Entity-relation joint extraction is a crucial technology for supporting intelligent question-answering systems, and data analysis applications. The aim of entity-relation joint extraction is to recognize named entities and extract relationships from unstructured text, and present entities and relations in the form of triples. Due to the sequential processing approach, the correlation and distinction between the features of the named entity recognition (NER) sub-task and the relation extraction (RE) sub-task are overlooked, resulting in insufficient feature interaction. To address this problem. This paper puts forward an entity-relation joint extraction method. This method is based on feature filtering and fusion. The model initially enhances entity and relation representations by encoding text and relations and filters out irrelevant feature information for entities and relations through partitioning. Subsequently, a feature fusion module is employed to fuse features to strengthen entity and relation representations. The experimental results on two public datasets prove that the model is capable of effectively dealing with the problem of information redundancy in overlapping entity-relation extraction.

articleTitle: Enhancing Lane Detection from Multi-Frame Continuous Driving Scenes Using Deep Neural Networks
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Computer Engineering (ICAICE)
abstract: Lane detection is one of the most critical components in autonomous driving and advanced driver assistance systems. Many excellent lane detection methods have been proposed in the past few years, but most of them still focus on single-image detection, which leads to often poor performance under extreme special conditions such as marker degradation, obstacle occlusion, and so on. In fact, lanes are typically continuous line structures, so we can utilize information from previous frames to infer lane information that cannot be accurately detected in the current frame. A new hybrid depth architecture has been proposed to combine CNN and RNN and use multi-frame information from continuous driving scenes to study lane detection, which has been proven to have good performance in lane detection, but still has room for improvement, this study proposes to introduce the UNet++ network and propose a new hybrid depth architecture, namely UNet++ _ ConvLSTM. This improved design enhances the model's ability to handle time series data. Through extensive experiments on two large-scale datasets, the method demonstrates better performance in lane detection, showing higher accuracy and recall, and significantly outperforming the original method, which validates the utility and reliability of the UNet++ _ ConvLSTM model in complex driving environments.

articleTitle: Intelligent Orientation Robot Based on Large Language Models and Retrieval-Augmented Generation
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Computer Engineering (ICAICE)
abstract: To address the issues of hallucination and knowledge security in large language models (LLMs) during Question and Answer processes, this project developed a Q&A platform integrating Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) with LLMs and enabled communication with intelligent robots. This project, applied to the university orientation scenario, built an orientation knowledge base comprising 11 categories of documents, about 300,000 words in all. By leveraging RAG for precise retrieval and using LLMs to generate logical and traceable answers, the system enhances both the accuracy and reliability of responses. The project also established remote communication with robots through the WebSocket protocol, offering flexible voice and touchscreen interaction, greatly improving the user experience. This platform not only improves the logical consistency of text-based Q&A but also strengthens the interaction between robots and users, providing a certain technical foundation for future multi-scenario intelligent interactions.

articleTitle: Population Density Estimation Network Based on Local Global Feature Fusion
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Computer Engineering (ICAICE)
abstract: In order to solve the difficulties caused by background interference, large scale changes, and crowd occlusion in population density estimation tasks, a population density estimation network based on local global feature fusion is proposed. Firstly, the backbone network adopts the VGG16 network architecture to extract shallow features; Secondly, the CBAM attention mechanism is introduced to generate spatial and channel dimension attention feature maps; Next, a global feature fusion module was designed to fuse the extracted local features with the global features; Finally, the density map is obtained through a backend network consisting of six dilated convolutional layers and one output layer. The network was tested and validated on three challenging datasets. The experimental results indicated that the proposed network's MAE and MSE metrics performed well overall, achieving good robustness and accuracy.

articleTitle: Application of Attention Mechanism-Based Neural Networks in Predicting Chemical Molecular Properties
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Computer Engineering (ICAICE)
abstract: The prediction of molecular properties is a hot issue in the field of materials chemistry, and the use of neural networks to predict chemical molecular properties is one of the more effective means. In recent years, with the deepening of the research, a variety of neural network prediction algorithms have appeared, such as the neural network combined with particle swarm algorithm and the prediction method based on RBF neural network. However, all these methods face the problems of difficult hyperparameter adjustment and local optimal solution. In this paper, the prediction of chemical molecule properties based on the attention mechanism-based neural network model is realized through the adaptive adjustment of the attention weights, which significantly improves the accuracy of the prediction of chemical molecule properties. Taking the complex property prediction of 100 chemical molecules as an example, taking the same test set, the loss function mean square deviation of the traditional neural network model on the test set is 978.3049079, and the attentional mechanism neural network model reduces this value to 931.909225, which significantly improves the accuracy of the prediction of chemical molecule properties. The study shows that the attention mechanism-based neural network model outperforms the traditional neural network model in molecular property prediction with higher prediction accuracy.

articleTitle: Research of Knowledge-Enhanced Large Language Model Based on Knowledge Graph
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Computer Engineering (ICAICE)
abstract: The rapid development and wide application of Knowledge Graph(KG) and Large Language Model(LLM) have demonstrated strong basic capabilities of artificial intelligence. In the last two years, related research has explored the combination of KG and LLM to improve the model's ability in text understanding and inference. In view of this kind of research, the basic knowledge of KG enhancing LLM is systematically introduced, and how KG enhances LLM from the perspective of functional realization is analyzed, and the existing research results of KG enhancing LLM is also summarized, which provides reference for further research on LLM enhanced by KG.

articleTitle: Vehicle Small Target Detection Algorithm for Remote Sensing Images Based on Improved YOLOv7-Tiny
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Computer Engineering (ICAICE)
abstract: Remote sensing images are widely used in analyzing various surface information due to their broad coverage and strong timeliness. However, in current target detection tasks for remote sensing images, challenges such as small target size and complex image backgrounds lead to high rates of omitted and incorrect detections. To address the issues of omitted and incorrect vehicle small target detection in remote sensing images and improve detection accuracy, this paper proposes an optimized vehicle small target detection algorithm based on YOLOv7-tiny. The algorithm introduces the SE attention mechanism into the Spatial Pyramid Pooling (SPP) module, optimizes the ELAN module, and replaces the original network's CIoU loss function with the SIoU loss function. These improvements enhance the network's sensitivity and discrimination for detecting small vehicle targets, thereby improving overall detection performance. Experimental results show that the proposed algorithm improves precision by 1.1%, recall by 0.7%, and mAP@0.5 by 1.0% on the UCAS-AOD dataset.

articleTitle: Exploring the Architecture and Functions of Intelligent Database Management Systems
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Computer Engineering (ICAICE)
abstract: This paper explores the architecture and functions of Intelligent Database Management Systems (IDBMS), which integrate advanced artificial intelligence (AI) technologies to enhance traditional database management. By addressing the limitations of conventional systems, IDBMS aim to improve query optimization, resource utilization, and user interaction through machine learning, predictive analytics, and natural language processing. The paper outlines the core components and architectural models of IDBMS, details their functionalities, presents case studies demonstrating their effectiveness, and discusses future trends and challenges in the field.

articleTitle: Continuous Wavelet Transform Based on A-Weighting
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Computer Engineering (ICAICE)
abstract: This paper introduces a novel sound signal analysis method by integrating A-weighting and Continuous Wavelet Transform (CWT) for fault diagnosis in noisy rotating machinery environments. Traditional methods like Fourier and Short-Time Fourier Transforms (STFT) struggle with non-stationary signals and faint fault features amidst complex noise. Our approach uses A-weighting to focus on human ear-sensitive frequencies, enhancing the detection of critical auditory components. Combined with CWT's exceptional time-frequency resolution, our method excels in identifying transient and subtle signal variations, proving superior in accuracy and intuitiveness for fault diagnosis under challenging noise conditions.

articleTitle: CRaFR: Connected Retrieval and Feedback Reading for Open Domain Reading Comprehension
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Computer Engineering (ICAICE)
abstract: Open-Domain Reading Comprehension (ODRC) involves retrieving relevant evidence from extensive corpora and then performing multi-text reading comprehension to extract text spans to answer questions. Current approaches typically divide the corpus into fixed-size chunks for retrieval and read, which may lead to insufficient retrieval when relevant evidence is distant, and only using answer string as a distant supervision signal also poses challenges for multi-text reading comprehension. To address this issue, we propose the Connected Retrieval and Feedback Reading (CRaFR) model. The CRaFR model enhances retrieval accuracy through associative retrieval of the search query and initial search texts. In the reading stage, the model integrates supporting information from multiple texts to select the optimal evidence and employs reinforcement learning with remote answer string supervision signals to refine the process. Experimental results on three benchmark datasets Natural Questions, WebQuestions and SQuAD-open demonstrate that CRaFR outperforms baseline models in retrieval recall and answer accuracy.

articleTitle: Research on Kiwifruit Detection Algorithm Based on Faster-YOLOv8n
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Computer Engineering (ICAICE)
abstract: In view of the complex structure of YOLOv8n model and the large amount of parameters and calculations of the existing kiwifruit detection algorithm, it is difficult to deploy in the terminal. This paper proposes a lightweight kiwifruit detection algorithm model Faster-YOLOv8n based on YOLOv8n. That is, all C2f modules in the YOLOv8n model are merged with the FasterNet lightweight network structure to form a new C2f-Faster module to reduce the consumption of computing resources. The experimental results show that the average detection accuracy mAP of the Faster-YOLOv8n algorithm on the self-made kiwifruit dataset collected in this paper is 96.9 %. Compared with the YOLOv8n algorithm, the model size is reduced by 32 %,the calculation amount is reduced by 22.2 %, the parameter quantity is reduced by 29.6 %, and the detection speed is increased by 26.7 %.Therefore, the detection method proposed in this paper reduces the consumption of computing resources and provides a theoretical reference for the lightweight detection of kiwifruit.

articleTitle: A Lightweight Cassava Leaf Disease Classification Algorithm Based on Iterative Weight Recycling
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Computer Engineering (ICAICE)
abstract: To address the challenges of large parameter sizes, high training costs, and difficulties in deploying convolutional neural networks (CNNs) for cassava leaf disease recognition on edge devices, this paper proposes a weight recycling-based model compression method for cassava leaf disease recognition. We involve randomly initializing the weights of a deep neural network and assigning importance scores to them, which serve as the basis for pruning. Subsequently, by optimizing the importance scores of the weights, parameters that have a significant impact on network performance are used to replace those with a lesser impact, identifying a well-performing sparse sub-network. Experimental results demonstrate that the cassava leaf disease classification model based on the weight recycling algorithm achieves an accuracy of 89.86% with a 70% reduction in parameter size, representing a 1.3% improvement compared to the dense network. This method provides a reference for the deployment of cassava leaf disease recognition models on edge devices and for reducing training costs.

articleTitle: Research on Classification Identification of Surface EMG Signals Based on Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Computer Engineering (ICAICE)
abstract: With the continuous development of robot technology in the field of industrial production, the introduction of biological electrical signals to control robots will not only provide a new way of human-computer interaction operation, but also improve the security and stability of the system. Among them, SEMG has a high signal-to-noise ratio, and the robot control accuracy based on SEMG is higher compared to other bioelectrical signals. This paper studies the classification and identification method of sEMG signals. Classified and of signals by constructing a one-dimensional convolutional neural network model. By studying the one-dimensional convolutional neural network from the horizontal and vertical dimensions respectively, the experimental results show that the accuracy of the horizontal dimension recognition is higher, which can reach 93.28%.

articleTitle: Estimation on Implied Volatility Based on Artificial Intelligence and its Application in Engineering
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Computer Engineering (ICAICE)
abstract: Implied volatility is derived by substituting the market prices of option into the theoretical price model. It is one of the key parameters in option pricing, used to describe the market's expectation of future asset price fluctuations. In this paper, the algorithm consisting of hybrid forecasting and wavelet neutral network is proposed. In this algorithm, the measurement for the weighted implied volatility is constructed as input of the neutral network. Its aim is to obtain the optimal weight of implied volatility by a series of options. Case study on the carbon option market implies that the model and algorithm proposed in this study have better precision than the traditional Black-Scholes model and other neutral work models.

articleTitle: Survey on Deep Learning Applications in Automated Chinese Poetry Composition
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Computer Engineering (ICAICE)
abstract: Chinese poetry generation is a challenging task in natural language processing that requires meeting various criteria, including structure, phonetics, and semantics. Early research employed methods such as genetic algorithms and statistical machine translation models; however, the quality and diversity of the generated poetry were limited. With the advancement of deep learning, recurrent neural networks (RNNs) and transformer models have become mainstream approaches due to their ability to capture long-distance dependencies. Reinforcement learning has also been introduced to enhance the diversity and coherence of generated poetry. Additionally, large-scale pretrained models based on BERT and GPT have shown the ability to produce high-quality poetry after fine-tuning. Nevertheless, current technologies still face challenges regarding poetry quality, precision in format control, and consistency in theme and emotion, indicating a need for further theoretical and technical exploration in the future

articleTitle: Sequential Recommendation Based on Bi-LSTM and Fourier Transform
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Computer Engineering (ICAICE)
abstract: The purpose of sequence recommendation is to determine the next item that the target user is most likely to be interested in based on user historical interaction data. However, these historical data frequently contain some noise interactions, which can hinder the precise learning of sequence representations and ultimately result in inaccurate recommendations for subsequent items. Besides, there is usually no explicit noise labelling in the data that renders the problem of sequence denoising particularly challenging. In this paper, we propose a new hierarchical sequence denoising method which employs bidirectional long short-term memory networks (Bi-LSTM) and Fourier Transform to denoise user sequences and subsequently generates noiseless data for use by sequential recommenders. The efficacy of our approach has been demonstrated through extensive experiments on three public benchmark datasets. Our proposed denoising model has been demonstrated to improve the performance of sequence recommendation methods based on Transformer by a range of 18.82% to 24.3%, and to outperform contemporary denoising methodologies.

articleTitle: Detection of Running Path of Rcore Operating System by Instrumentation
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Computer Engineering (ICAICE)
abstract: In order to explore the running path of the rCore operating system, so as to understand and improve the operating system, this paper has designed and implemented a kernel instrumentation program, which is inserted into the function of the source program of the rCore operating system, and the running track of the kernel is collected and stored in the memory, and then output the track information in the memory at a suitable location. The trajectory information reflects the details of the interaction between the operating system and the application programs, and provides help for kernel transformation.

articleTitle: Tour Guide Robot Based on Large Language Model and User Behavior Analysis
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Computer Engineering (ICAICE)
abstract: With the continuous development of human-computer interaction technology, the applications of tour guide robots in scenarios such as museums and exhibition halls are becoming increasingly widespread. However, traditional tour guide robots primarily rely on predefined content and texts, as well as pre-planned routes, making it difficult to adjust in real-time based on the diverse needs and interests of different visitors. This limitation restricts interactivity and engagement. To address this issue, this paper proposes an intelligent tour guide robot system that integrates large language model and user behavior analysis technology, aimed at dynamically adjusting tour content by real-time perception of visitors' interests. This system leverages the natural language processing capabilities of large language model, along with user behavior analysis techniques, to provide visitors with a more personalized and interactive tour experience. Experimental validation shows that the proposed tour guide robot system can enhance the accuracy and proactivity of tour presentations, thereby increasing user engagement and the overall effectiveness of the tour.

articleTitle: Design of Interactive Teaching System Based on Wireless Charging Technology
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Computer Engineering (ICAICE)
abstract: Aiming at the problems of low efficiency of device charging and insufficient system stability in interactive teaching systems, this study conducts a research on the design and implementation methods based on wireless charging technology. In order to solve this problem, integrated system architecture, intelligent control algorithm improvement and efficient simulation and testing methods are proposed, aiming to enhance the convenience of charging teaching equipment and optimize system operation efficiency and stability. The optimization of the system architecture, the application of intelligent control algorithms and the efficient simulation test in this study achieve the convenient charging of equipment, efficient operation and stable system performance in the interactive teaching system. The results of simulation experiments show that the scheme effectively improves the charging efficiency of the equipment and the stability of the system operation, and has the ability to solve the charging challenges in the interactive teaching system. The results show that this technical method has the potential for practical application in the teaching system.

articleTitle: Artificial Intelligence in Standard Knowledge Services: Roles and Implementation
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Computer Engineering (ICAICE)
abstract: To improve the efficiency and accuracy of standard knowledge services, this paper explores the application of multimodal knowledge representation, knowledge graph construction, and intelligent question-and-answer (QA) systems. By leveraging deep learning and natural language processing (NLP) technologies, the system achieves automated classification, semantic analysis, and decision support for standard documents. The analysis suggests that the combination of knowledge graphs and intelligent QA systems can significantly enhance the precision of information retrieval and the automation of standardized processes. The results show that the system performs excellently in terms of response speed, user satisfaction, and performance metrics.

articleTitle: New Approaches to Automated Software Testing Based on Artificial Intelligence
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Computer Engineering (ICAICE)
abstract: With the increasing complexity of software development, traditional automated testing methods face significant challenges in efficiency and coverage. This paper proposes a novel AI-driven automated testing method aimed at optimizing test case generation and selection through machine learning and deep learning techniques. Experimental results demonstrate that this approach significantly enhances test coverage and accuracy, addressing limitations inherent in existing methods. This research provides new insights for automation and intelligence in the field of software testing, advancing the application of artificial intelligence in software engineering.

articleTitle: Multi-AGV Formation Path Planning Based on an Improved A* Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Computer Engineering (ICAICE)
abstract: For the application scenario of aircraft transfer within hangars using a formation of three AGVs with omnidirectional mobility, this paper proposes a multi-AGV formation path planning method based on an improved A * algorithm. The method integrates an obstacle height evaluation mechanism during the node expansion process of the A * algorithm. Additionally, the heuristic function is enhanced, and a dynamic neighborhood search strategy is adopted to optimize node expansion. Key path nodes are extracted, followed by smoothing of the planned path. Simulation results demonstrate that the improved A * algorithm offers significant advantages over the traditional algorithm in terms of space utilization, search efficiency, and path smoothness, providing a more reliable and efficient solution for practical applications.

articleTitle: Continuous Finger Joint Angle Estimation by a sEMG-FMG-Driven Explainable Gate-Recurrent Unit Network with Cross-Modality Multihead Attention
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Computer Engineering (ICAICE)
abstract: Decoding movement intention is crucial for human-machine interaction (HMI). However, accurate finger joint angle (FJA) estimation is still a challenge. To address this problem, in this study, a gate-recurrent unit network with attention (GRU-Attention) was proposed, and hybrid surface electromyography (sEMG) and force myography (FMG) modality was selected as decoding information source due to its promising potential in improving estimation accuracy. The model utilizes two-stream GRU network to encode and decode information, and adds cross-modality multihead attention (CMMA) mechanism after the encoder block to fuse multimodal information. Five hand movements were estimated. Ablation studies demonstrated that adding the CMMA mechanism and multimodality can effectively improve estimation accuracy, and adding the CMMA mechanism was superior to that of multihead self-attention mechanism. Moreover, the average NRMSE of the proposed model (0.0633±0.0030) was significantly less than that of the convolution neural networks and long short-term memory CNN-LSTM model (0.0726±0.0034, <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$p$</tex><0.001) and the CNN and Transformer model (0.0686±0.0033, <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$p$</tex>=0.027). Moreover, the proposed model has an explainable prediction mechanism, as feature importance was quantified by attention weights.

articleTitle: Automatic Detection of Ocular Surface Disease on Smartphone Images using Improved YOLOv5
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Computer Engineering (ICAICE)
abstract: The significant increase in the number of patients with ocular diseases has made medical institutions face great challenges. At present, computer aided diagnosis technology is urgently needed to assist doctors in clinical diagnosis of ocular surface diseases. In view of the application scenario of eye surface image disease detection, we proposed to improve the automatic detection of ocular surface diseases of YOLOv5. The CBAM attention module was introduced in the feature extraction stage of YOLOv5, and C3 module was improved to CBAMC3 module, which enhanced the feature extraction capability and made the backbone network more focused on the lesion area of the eye surface. Subsequently, the BiFPN module was introduced into the neck network to further enhance the feature fusion capability and improve the detection accuracy of eye surface disease images. The experimental results show that the mAP of ocular surface diseases detection by our proposed method in the test set is 97.9<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">%</sup>, which realizes the automatic detection and localization of ocular surface diseases, and has good auxiliary diagnostic significance.

articleTitle: On the Information Cocoon Effect in the TikTok Recommendation Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Computer Engineering (ICAICE)
abstract: Although the commercial improvement of the recommendation algorithm has led to the rapid rise of short video platforms represented by TikTok, it has also contributed to the social problem of information cocoons. The recommendation algorithm for business services has the characteristics of customization, circle and entertainment, and in the process of operation, the algorithm gradually shows an extreme tendency-personal customization closed loop, group polarization and entertainment to death. In this regard, this paper proposes to establish a people-oriented human-computer interaction mechanism, optimize the display mechanism of the comment area, and rationally allocate the proportion of recommended content types to cope with the alienation caused by the current TikTok recommendation algorithm due to lack of value.

articleTitle: Integrating Hidden Features of ELM Auto-Encoder for Cancer Multi-Omics Data Clustering
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Computer Engineering (ICAICE)
abstract: Clustering analysis of multi-omics integration has become a critical approach in cancer subtypes identification. Integration methods always confront with the problem of high dimensionality in biological data. For an extreme learning machine auto-encoder(ELM-AE) model, the hidden features can be a compressed representation of the input data if the nodes number of hidden layers is much less than that of the input layer. Here, we propose to integrate hidden features of ELM-AE for cancer multi-omics data clustering. To evaluate the effectiveness, we apply our approach on breast multi-omics clustering and the identified cancer subtypes reveal more significant patient outcomes.

articleTitle: A Web Service for HTCondor Scheduling System
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Computer Engineering (ICAICE)
abstract: As a high throughput computing (HTC) task scheduling system, the HTCondor (hereinafter called Condor) has been widely applied in the field of high-energy physics computing and analysis, due to its open-source, installation-friendly and better scheduling algorithm. Many research institutes deployed Condor on their computing clusters to complete the resource management and task scheduling. However, Condor is lack of a user-friendly web interface. Some beginners or students, who are not familiar with Condor, have to spend time to figure out the rules about how to submit and manage their computing or analysis tasks using condor-specified commands. Fortunately, Condor provides several application programming interfaces (APIs), which makes it possible to develop relevant application or service according to the actual environment. Herein, by utilizing the Condor python interface combined with the currently popular VUE front-end architecture, we developed a web service for Condor system. Instead of using condor commands, users can submit, query and control their HTC tasks on a web browser. This work brings great convenience to Condor system users, especially for beginners and students. Besides, it also provides a real-time monitor function, which makes more convenient and intuitive for users and system managers to monitor the cluster resources and tasks' status in real time.

articleTitle: Quality Prediction of Health Articles Based on the BERT-WWM Model
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Computer Engineering (ICAICE)
abstract: The quality of online health information is crucial for patients' decision-making and health outcomes. This paper primarily employs machine learning models to study and implement the automatic evaluation of the content quality of health promotion articles on online medical platforms. Utilizing a dataset of real health promotion articles and community user voting data, this paper introduces the prediction of health article quality based on the Chinese BERT-WWM model, along with a comparative analysis of various other machine learning algorithms. Significant differences in the predictive performance of different models are observed, with the fine-tuned BERT-WWM model achieving the best results. It not only reached the highest accuracy but also attained a recall rate of 62% for high-quality articles, while the worst-performing model achieved only 31%. This deep analysis of health promotion articles on online medical platforms using deep learning models contributes to the advancement of smart healthcare.

articleTitle: Beef Quality Management Under Full Chain Monitoring: Innovation Integrating IoT and Blockchain
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Computer Engineering (ICAICE)
abstract: With the growth of global population and rising living standards, people's demand for high-quality meat products is rising. The traditional beef cattle breeding mode is facing challenges such as high resource consumption, low production efficiency and serious environmental impact. This system deeply combines the Internet of things and blockchain, covering the design and deployment of IOT sensors, the application integration of ESP32 module, the construction of the underlying technology of FISCO-BCOS blockchain, the preparation and implementation of smart contracts, and the development and application of visual interactive terminals. It has injected new vitality into traditional animal husbandry by integrating advanced information technology, Internet of things, blockchain and other means.

articleTitle: Design of Electric Vehicle Helmet Wearing Detection System Based on YOLOV5 Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Computer Engineering (ICAICE)
abstract: With the worsening of urban traffic congestion, electric vehicles have become an effective means of transportation to overcome congestion. Proper wearing of helmets is crucial for reducing casualties in traffic accidents. This study utilizes the YOLOv5 algorithm and publicly available data to train a model. By continuously modifying and adjusting parameters, it achieves accurate detection of helmet wearing by electric vehicle drivers in various complex situations such as different weather conditions, lighting conditions, roads, multiple people, color tones, and not wearing helmets or other hats.

articleTitle: YOLOv10-LPRNet: A Three-Region Multi-License Plate Recognition Model Based on YOLOv10 and LPRNet
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Computer Engineering (ICAICE)
abstract: With the promotion of the cross-boundary driving policy in recent years, the volume of cross-boundary vehicular traffic between Hong Kong, Macao, and the Mainland has increased significantly. However, the different license plate systems of the three regions bring new challenges to traffic management and toll collection systems. Traditional license plate recognition models are mostly trained based on data from a single region, making it difficult to cope with cross-border recognition demands. In this study, a three-land multi-license plate recognition model based on YOLOv10 and LPRNet is proposed to achieve efficient recognition of multiple license plate systems in Hong Kong, Macao, and Mainland China. It is verified that the use of YOLOv10 for target detection in combination with LPRNet character recognition helps to improve the accuracy and efficiency of cross-border license plate recognition. The experimental results show that the YOLOv10-LPRNet model achieves an accuracy of 98.4% in the three-land license plate dataset, which is better than the existing license plate recognition models.

articleTitle: Research on Intelligent Detection Method of Power Transmission Components Based on Image Enhancement
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Computer Engineering (ICAICE)
abstract: Transmission lines, as an important carrier of power transmission, are the part of the power grid with the widest distribution coverage. Among them, transmission components bear the important role of electrical insulation and line protection, and timely defect detection of transmission components is a key factor to ensure the stable operation of the power system. Existing defect detection of transmission components is mainly carried out by means of UAV inspection, but the image background of transmission components obtained from UAV aerial photography is complex, and the defect size is small, which is prone to problems such as misdetection and omission detection. For this reason, an image enhancement-based defect detection method for transmission components is proposed to improve the accuracy of defect detection. First, image enhancement is performed on the original transmission component image based on two algorithms, Retinex and CLAHE, to enhance the image details while improving the local contrast; then, the image processed by the above two methods is fused to retain the important information of the image and improve the information content of the image; finally, the fused image is input into a convolutional neural network, and the defect detection is carried out after the fully connected layer and softmax classifier. Defect detection. Taking the defective images of transmission line insulators as the experimental dataset, the experimental results show that the method proposed in this paper can effectively improve the accuracy of fault diagnosis of transmission components.

articleTitle: Fine-Grained Gesture Recognition Based on Machine Learning via RFID
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Computer Engineering (ICAICE)
abstract: Gesture recognition is becoming an essential part of smart living. Commercial RFID devices have played a crucial role in advancing gesture recognition due to their low cost, broad applicability, and ease of deployment. This paper proposes a commercial RFID-based contactless gesture recognition system that utilizes an improved Varri segmentation algorithm to accurately identify the start and end segments of gesture signals. By employing wavelet decomposition, fine-grained features of the gestures are extracted, enabling efficient capture of dynamic, detailed gesture signals. Evaluated through extensive gesture recognition experiments simulating real-world scenarios, this method achieves an average recognition accuracy of 98.2% in an empty room and 97.4% in a noisy classroom. The results demonstrate high recognition accuracy and robustness of the method.

articleTitle: Directed Adaptive Multi-Channel Graph Convolutional Network
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Computer Engineering (ICAICE)
abstract: Compared with traditional neural networks, graph convolutional networks are very suitable for processing graph structured data. However, common graph convolutional network methods often have unsatisfactory results when dealing with directed network structures. Because common graph convolutional network methods are mostly applied in the field of undirected graphs, they tend to symmetrize the network structure, resulting in the loss of relevant information about asymmetry. In order to improve the performance of graph neural networks on directed graphs, this paper proposes a semi supervised classification adaptive multi-channel graph convolutional network for directed graphs. The core idea of the method is to use the directed triangle counting algorithm to extract similar features of in degree and out degree in the topology structure, and combine node features and topology features to extract special and common embeddings in a multi-channel fusion manner, and use attention mechanism to learn the adaptive important weights of embeddings. Experiments were conducted using multiple benchmark datasets in both directed and undirected scenarios, and the results showed that the model can be effectively applied in both directed and undirected graphs. The loss is minimal when transitioning from undirected to directed, and the classification accuracy is improved.

articleTitle: Sensor Layout Optimization for Sand Mill Using DEM Coupled with CFD
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Computer Engineering (ICAICE)
abstract: Sensor layout is essential for efficiently exploring the grinding state of wet grinding equipment. The computational fluid dynamics-discrete element method (CFD-DEM) fluid-solid coupling simulation is used in this study to obtain the collision energy data of grinding beads and cylinder wall under 27 working conditions. Based on the Taguchi experimental design, this approach also determined the optimal sensor layout position on the sand mill cylinder during wet grinding. According to the defined sensitivity index, the sensitivity of different areas divided by the cylinder wall to the change of the grinding process was quantified, and the area with a high sensitivity index was established as the optimal sensor layout position. The results reveal that the grinding process conditions considerably affect the sensor layout position. The sensor is optimally arranged in the grinding wheel area when the grinding wheel speeds are 1000 rpm and 1200 rpm, the filling rates are 70% and 80%, and the grinding bead diameters are 1 and 1.2 mm. Moreover, the sensor is optimally arranged in the diffusion wheel area at a filling rate of 60% and a grinding bead diameter of 0.8 mm. Finally, the sensor is optimally arranged in the grinding wheel area and the diffusion wheel area, respectively, at the grinding wheel speed of 1400 rpm.

articleTitle: Enhanced YOLOv8 Model for Insulator Defect Detection using Generalized Loss and Depthwise Convolution Techniques
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Computer Engineering (ICAICE)
abstract: This paper proposes an enhanced YOLOv8 model that integrates Generalized Loss Objective Design (GLOD) and Depthwise Convolution (DWConv) to tackle complex object detection tasks. Traditional detection models often struggle with performance drops and increased computational load when dealing with dense small objects, occlusions, and multi-scale targets. To address this, the improved architecture leverages GLOD's adaptive loss balancing for better classification and regression, significantly boosting detection accuracy, especially for small, densely packed targets. Meanwhile, DWConv reduces computational costs while maintaining feature extraction capacity, enhancing model efficiency. Experimental results show that with GLOD, the mAP increased to 89.7%, and further improved to 91.3% with DWConv.

articleTitle: Reverse Margin Inference Attack: Overcoming Adversarial Robustness via Margin Loss Manipulation
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Computer Engineering (ICAICE)
abstract: Deep neural networks (DNNs) have shown remarkable success in many domains but remain vulnerable to adversarial attacks that exploit slight perturbations in input data to deceive models. This paper introduces a novel adversarial attack method, Reverse Margin Inference Attack (RMIA), which targets defenses that manipulate the margin loss curve. RMIA utilizes Linear Reverse and Sine Reverse transformations to effectively counteract these defenses by restoring the original margin loss, thereby enhancing attack success. Experimental results on CIFAR-10 and ImageNet datasets demonstrate that RMIA significantly reduces model accuracy while improving query efficiency compared to traditional attacks. RMIA's effectiveness is evident across various defensive strategies, showcasing its robustness and efficiency. These findings underscore RMIA's potential to provide new insights into advancing adversarial attack methodologies and challenging existing defensive mechanisms.

articleTitle: Optimization Design of Internal Unstable Flow Characteristics in Centrifugal Pumps Based on Support Vector Machine
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Computer Engineering (ICAICE)
abstract: In view of the internal unstable flow phenomenon that was prone to occur in centrifugal pumps during operation, this paper adopted the Support Vector Machine (SVM) method to optimize the structural parameters of the pump. Based on the hydraulic design principle, a mathematical model of the centrifugal pump was established, and the velocity, pressure, and turbulence kinetic energy distribution inside the pump were analyzed through numerical simulation. The SVM was used to optimize the structural parameters of the pump, determining the optimal inlet and outlet placement angles to reduce flow separation and turbulence losses. Through experimental verification on an external characteristic test bench, the optimized pump showed significant improvements in head and efficiency, increasing by 15.66% and 15.92% respectively. The research results showed that the optimization method based on SVM could effectively improve the internal flow characteristics of centrifugal pumps, enhance the working performance and service life of the pump, and had important theoretical and practical value.

articleTitle: Research on Automated Text Summarization of Medical Literature Using Transformer Models
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Computer Engineering (ICAICE)
abstract: The exponential growth of the medical literature presents a significant challenge for medical professionals, who are required to keep abreast of the vast amount of information. The application of automated text summarisation technology facilitates the distillation of key insights from lengthy literature, thereby enhancing the accessibility of information and the efficiency of clinical decision-making. The objective of this study was to develop a method for generating abstracts from medical literature based on the Transformer model. The proposed model employs a pre-trained Bidirectional Encoder Representation Model (BERT) architecture, which has been fine-tuned for a substantial corpus of medical texts in order to capture domain-specific language patterns and contexts. The incorporation of the multi-head self-attention mechanism enables the model to effectively identify and emphasise the most pertinent information within the literature, thereby facilitating the generation of a succinct and coherent summary. The experimental analysis demonstrates that the model outperforms the traditional summarisation technique in terms of ROUGE score, while preserving the integrity of the medical information.

articleTitle: Development of a Virtual Simulation-Based Automated Production Line Experiment Platform
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Computer Engineering (ICAICE)
abstract: Currently, conducting experiments in colleges and universities is more difficult because of issues such as lack of room and inadequate equipment. Furthermore, it is possible that the experimental teaching strategies already in use do not adequately address the needs of the manufacturing staff training. The course on automated production line control technology uses virtual reality technology to combine industry-wide automation production line training with virtual simulations in order to address the aforementioned problems. As a result, an automated production line simulation experimental platform is built, enabling students to finish educational experiments without being limited by time or location. The virtual simulation experimental platform has proven to be effective in raising students' learning objectives, deepening their comprehension of the material, and developing superior practical abilities.

articleTitle: State of Charge Estimation for Lithium-Ion Batteries Based on IGA-EKPF
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Computer Engineering (ICAICE)
abstract: The State of Charge (SOC) of lithium-ion batteries plays a crucial role in energy management and prolonging battery life. Stable and accurate SOC estimation enables the battery management system to operate safely and reliably. To address the issue of insufficient SOC estimation accuracy in lithium-ion batteries, an improved Genetic Algorithm (IGA) and Extended Kalman Particle Filter (EKPF) are proposed to achieve both parameter identification for the battery model and SOC estimation. Based on the development of a bipolar model, the impact of initial condition uncertainty and measurement errors is mitigated by using the Genetic Algorithm's global search capabilities and regularization terms in the fitness calculation. This approach allows for precise parameter identification by minimizing the terminal voltage error. With accurate model parameters obtained, the EKPF is used for online estimation. During the particle filter state update, the Kalman gain is applied to update the particle states, improving the particle quality and resampling effectiveness by optimizing the weight of each particle. This enhances the accuracy and robustness of the estimation. The final SOC estimation results from the IGA-EKPF algorithm show an average absolute error of 0.37%, a root mean square error of 0.44%, and a maximum error of 2.6%. Experimental results verify the feasibility and accuracy of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Observer-Based Leader-Following Secure Consensus for Multi-Agent Systems with Nonlinear Dynamics and External Disturbance Under Denial of Service Attacks
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Computer Engineering (ICAICE)
abstract: This paper introduces an Unknown Input Observer (UIO) for nonlinear systems with One-Sided Lipschitz (OSL) and Quadratic Inner-Boundedness (QIB) properties. The UIO enables unknown input reconstruction and state estimation. Besides the UIO show resilience against Denial of Service (DoS) attacks that can disrupt multi-agent communication. To counteract these attacks, the system uses buffer units to retain real-time data, allowing agents to access the latest states during disruptions. We present a control protocol that facilitates leader-follower consensus under simultaneous DoS attacks, detailing the upper limits on their frequency and duration. Numerical simulations demonstrate the approach's effectiveness.

articleTitle: Token Embedding Graph Neural Network for Paper Classification
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Computer Engineering (ICAICE)
abstract: The topic classification task on academic papers significantly contributes to the analysis of valuable papers. Classic methods first build a paper citation graph and then classify each paper node with a graph neural network (GNN). Some successors notice the rich semantics within the text features, namely the title and abstract of one paper, and start to extract the node representation from a text attributed graph (TAG). But the heterogeneity between graph topology and text sequence requires the representation learning algorithm to aggregate knowledge from both sides. Existing works embed the text feature in the corresponding node directly with a separate language model, so as to couple the knowledge in a cascading style. However, this text embedding algorithm faces a severe problem on calculation complexity because of the coupling. Given that the complexity of GNN grows exponentially as the number of layers increases, the high cost of the language model is further amplified to an intolerable degree. To conquer this challenge, we propose the token embedding graph neural network (TEGNN). Instead of cascading the language model and GNN, a shared token embedding layer is introduced to serve as the knowledge link between them. This structure decouples two modules without any knowledge loss, decreasing the complexity considerably. Experiments on the large-scale dataset prove the enhancement of efficiency. Compared with baseline algorithms, TEGNN decreases the training time by 70.17% on condition that the classification accuracy is increased by 1.04%.

articleTitle: Research on Multi-Stage Path Planning for Human-Multi-Robot Collaboration Assembly
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Computer Engineering (ICAICE)
abstract: Multi-robot collaborative operation is an important component of current intelligent manufacturing. In this paper, the task allocation and multi-stage path planning are studied for human-multi-robot collaboration. In particular, a genetic algorithm based on task directed graph (TDG-GA) is proposed to achieve the optimal task allocation and multi-stage path planning of robots. In TDG-GA, the particle swarm optimization algorithm is firstly employed to plan the optimal path for each task of industrial robot, and then, the auction process constrained by task directed graph is integrated into genetic algorithm to allocate the tasks. Finally, the task sequence is integrated with the optimal path to generate the multi-stage paths for each industrial robot. A reducer collaboration assembly experiment is used to verify the effectiveness of TDG-GA.

articleTitle: Study on Wind Power Prediction by Integrating Multi-Source Factors and Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Computer Engineering (ICAICE)
abstract: This study develops a wind power forecasting model that integrates multiple meteorological factors. The model is based on a CNN-BiLSTM-Attention network, designed to enhance the accuracy of wind power generation forecasts. In the wind power generation industry, accurate power prediction is extremely critical to ensure grid reliability and efficient operation of the electricity market. The model integrates a Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) to capture local patterns in meteorological data, a Bidirectional Long Short-Term Memory Network (BiLSTM) to identify long-term dependencies in the time series, and an Attention mechanism to aggregate the features that have the most significant impact on the prediction results. By integrating this multimodal machine learning technique, the model efficiently handles complex nonlinear interactions and fully leverages diverse meteorological data to predict wind power generation. The model is trained and validated using actual meteorological and power data from a wind farm, and the experimental results prove that this model is significantly better than the traditional single LSTM and single BiLSTM models in terms of prediction accuracy, showing more accurate prediction capability and stronger stability. This result provides an effective tool for the operation and management of wind farms and promotes the optimal allocation and dispatch of power resources.

articleTitle: Research on Mine Personnel Helmet Detection Based on Improved YOLOv8n
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Computer Engineering (ICAICE)
abstract: Aiming at the problem that the complex environment of mines affects the image quality, the image enhancement method of image brightness enhancement and illumination unevenness treatment is proposed. In order to improve the accuracy of small target detection of mine operator helmet and reduce the computational volume, the YOLOv8n algorithm is improved, the Backbone structure is optimized, the FasterNet module is introduced to reduce the number of parameters, and the CBAM attention mechanism is added to improve the recognition ability. Tested on the coal mine personnel helmet dataset, the average accuracy of the improved algorithm reaches 95.0 % and 95.3 %, which is 14.7 % and 13.9 % higher than that of the original YOLOv8n, and effectively reduces the leakage and misdetection, which verifies the practical value of the improved algorithm and the application scenarios.

articleTitle: Lightweight Pose Estimation Based on Adaptive Robust Loss and Attention Mechanism
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Computer Engineering (ICAICE)
abstract: With the advancement of deep learning techniques, human pose estimation has become a key research area in computer vision. This study enhances the lightweight pose estimation framework, Lite-HRNet, by introducing Global Grouped Coordinate Attention (GGCA) and Multi-Scale Dilated Fusion Attention (MDFA) to improve the model's ability to capture both fine details and contextual information. Additionally, an adaptive robust loss function is employed to optimize the training process, strengthening the model's capability to handle outliers and improving overall robustness. Experiments on the COCO val2017 dataset show a 1.4% increase in mean Average Precision (mAP), while maintaining the same parameter count and computational complexity (GFLOPs), demonstrating the effectiveness of the proposed approach in boosting human pose estimation performance.

articleTitle: A Chinese Address Parsing Algorithm Based on Mengzi-BiLSTM-CRF
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Computer Engineering (ICAICE)
abstract: Chinese addresses have characteristics such as flexible writing formats, numerous omitted aliases, and strong regional features, which complicate address parsing, standardization, and matching. To overcome these challenges, a Chinese address parsing algorithm based on Mengzi-BiLSTM-CRF is proposed. This algorithm can effectively identify address elements and their corresponding types. Comparative experiments on different word vector representations and sequence labeling models show that Mengzi-BiLSTM-CRF outperforms Bert-BiLSTM-CRF, achieving an F1 score of 91.87%. Compared with other named entity recognition algorithms, Mengzi-BiLSTM-CRF also demonstrates superior performance.

articleTitle: Optimization of Distributed Algorithms in Cloud Computing Environment
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Computer Engineering (ICAICE)
abstract: This thesis aims to explore the optimization strategies of distributed algorithms in cloud computing environment. With the rapid development of cloud computing, traditional distributed algorithms face many challenges, such as network latency, resource scheduling and data consistency. By analyzing the limitations of existing algorithms, scheduling strategies based on resource optimization, algorithm adaptation schemes in heterogeneous environments, and load balancing techniques are proposed. The study shows that these optimization strategies can significantly improve the performance and scalability of the algorithms, providing a theoretical basis and practical guidance for future cloud computing applications.

articleTitle: Coupled Lateral and Longitudinal Control Systems with Planning for Autonomous Vehicles
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Computer Engineering (ICAICE)
abstract: Autonomous driving technology is advancing rapidly and is becoming an indispensable part of the world's automation landscape. Achieving effective control and planning for autonomous vehicles is crucial to ensuring their safe and efficient operation. This paper begins by introducing a vehicle dynamics model that enables autonomous vehicles to track desired trajectories while avoiding both static and dynamic obstacles. A dynamics-based control system is designed, including DLQR lateral control and dual-loop PID longitudinal control. Addition-ally, decision-making and path-planning algorithms, based on dynamic programming (DP) and quadratic programming (QP), are developed to generate optimal speed and path plans. These algorithms use S-T graphs to achieve dynamic and static obstacle avoidance. Multiple simulation tools are utilized to test the performance of the system, including trajectory tracking, static obstacle avoidance, and dynamic obstacle avoidance scenarios involving pedestrian crossings. Simulation results demonstrate that the proposed system meets the expected performance, showcasing the feasibility and effectiveness of the coupled control and decision-making framework for autonomous driving.

articleTitle: Multi-Modal Emotion Recognition Network with Balanced Audio-Visual Feature Extraction
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Computer Engineering (ICAICE)
abstract: Video and audio are ways for humans to perceive the world beyond language. It is meant to enable robots to imitate and recognize human emotional expressions. However, most current audio-visual emotion analysis models tend to extract deep features from only one modality. In contrast, the other modality plays a supporting role and cannot fully extract deep features from both modalities. This article proposes a balanced audio-visual emotion analysis model. Specifically, EfficientNet and Wav2vec 2.0 are used for visual and auditory modality feature extraction, respectively, ensuring that indepth features can be extracted from both modalities. Secondly, we use Transformer as the decision-level fusion operator, exchanging information between the two modalities. We verified our model on the RAVDESS dataset and achieved a Top1 accuracy of 88.54%, surpassing audio-visual emotion analysis models of the auxiliary type.

articleTitle: Hot Rolled Wire Tracking Based on Adaptive Threshold Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Computer Engineering (ICAICE)
abstract: Accurate tracking of the production process of hotrolled wire rod is of great importance for achieving closed-loop production control, predicting the evolution of temperature and microstructure fields, and analysing the causes of product quality problems. Traditionally, the method of installing additional dedicated in-situ detection sensors has resulted in high installation and maintenance costs. In this study, the existing operating current of the rolling mill motor on the production line and the infrared thermometer on the Stelmor production line are used as in-position evaluation signals to achieve wire tracking. A adaptive threshold algorithm is proposed to solve the problem of in-situ state misjudgment caused by degree deviation in infrared thermometers. The result indicated that, the tracking accuracy can reach 91.0% and calculation duration is less than 20ms.

articleTitle: Automatic Segmentation of Remote Sensing Agricultural-Land Based on SAM
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Computer Engineering (ICAICE)
abstract: It is very important to extract agricultural information, especially farmland plots, from remote sensing satellite images, especially in agricultural yield estimation, monitoring and measurement of farmland area. In the past, farmland measurement was done manually, which consumed huge costs and efforts. With the development of artificial intelligence, the technology of remote sensing farmland segmentation has evolved from machine learning to convolutional neural networks and ViT, making farmland segmentation more and more accurate. However, the generalization performance of these neural network models is not very ideal. The SAM model released by Meta last year is far ahead in terms of generalization. SAM is based on manual prompting model segmentation.
