Based on the improvement of SAM, our experimental results show that it has better generalization and accuracy than the original SAM and other segmentation networks such as mask2former, UNet, etc.

articleTitle: Tobacco-Seg-YOLOvll for Image Segmentation Algorithm of Flue-Cured Tobacco under Complex Background
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Computer Engineering (ICAICE)
abstract: To address the challenges posed by the variable and complex backgrounds of flue-cured tobacco images, which arise from differences in image acquisition devices in actual flue-cured tobacco purchase processing and are difficult for traditional image segmentation algorithms to effectively process, a flue-cured tobacco image segmentation network based on the YOLOv11-nano, Tobacco-Seg-YOLOv11 was proposed. Firstly, images were collected and annotated using four different devices to construct the Tobacco-Seg dataset. Secondly, the Tobacco-Seg-YOLOv11 network structure was built and optimized by introducing lightweight modules such as SCDown, C3Ghost, and LADH to adapt to the recognition and segmentation of flue-cured tobacco against complex backgrounds. Finally, the effectiveness of the algorithm was validated through multiple sets of experiments. The results showed that the proposed Tobacco-Seg-YOLOv11 algorithm achieves segmentation mAP50 and mAP50:95 metrics of 99.1% and 95.8%, respectively, with a parameter count and computational load of 1.41M and 7.6G Floats. Compared to YOLOv11n, it reduced the parameter counts by 50.4% and computational load by 25.5%, while improving segmentation accuracy by 0.4%. It demonstrates high segmentation accuracy in complex backgrounds, meeting the practical requirements for flue-cured tobacco image segmentation.

articleTitle: A Cooperative LiDAR Perception Method in V2I Scenario
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Computer Engineering (ICAICE)
abstract: In single-vehicle autonomous driving, the quality of perception is compromised by blind spots arising from limited sensor range and obstacles. Consequently, vehicle-road cooperative perception has been introduced as a means to address these limitations. However, the perceptual information obtained from other traffic participants cannot be directly leveraged to enhance perception due to the heterogeneity of the data observed from different perspectives. To overcome this challenge, a point cloud fusion framework with a preprocessing method is proposed for facilitating vehicle-road cooperation, enabling the implementation of localization of vehicle and distance measurement of pedestrians in blind spots. Experimental results under real-world scenarios demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed fusion framework. With the inclusion of the preprocessing step, the errors of point cloud registration, localization of intelligent connected vehicles (ICV), and distance measurement between pedestrians and ICV decreased by more than 90% while the consumed time decreased by more than 98%.

articleTitle: Transmission Line Power Fixture Defect Detection Method Based on Mobile-YOLOv5s
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Computer Engineering (ICAICE)
abstract: Transmission line power fittings are an vital part of the modern power system, ensuring the safety and reliability of grid lines operating in different environments. Defects in power fixtures in transmission lines, such as slack wires of bolt pins and missing insulator blocks, are very likely to cause damage to power equipment, interrupt power supply, and affect the safety and stability of the power system. Efficient and accurate target detection technology can quickly capture the fixtures and their defects, helping technicians find potential grid safety hazards in a timely manner. Therefore, based on YOLOv5s model, the backbone network is replaced with MobileNetv3 model to improve the inference speed; SELayer attention mechanism is introduced into the C3 module to enhance the feature extraction ability of the model; a small target detection architecture is referenced to the detection head part to enhance the model's performance to detect minor targets; finally, the localisation loss function, CIOU, is substituted for the EIOU loss function. The improved Mobile-YOLOv5s model has a detection accuracy of 96.2%, a value of 95.7% for mAP0.5, an FPS value of 102, and a prediction average accuracy of 0.98 on the test set, which meets the detection performance requirements of the real environment.

articleTitle: A Lightweight Neural Network for Ocular Surface Disease Recognition
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Computer Engineering (ICAICE)
abstract: Common ocular surface diseases are one of the main reasons for ophthalmic patients to see a doctor. While deep convolutional neural networks are excellent at classifying diseases on the ocular surface, these models typically require a large number of parameters and computational resources, limiting their deployment on resource-limited devices. Therefore, we designed and developed a lightweight network consisting of standard convolution, depthwise separable convolution and Ghost module three branches for automatic recognition of four types of ocular surface: normal, pterygium, conjunctival congestion and conjunctival pigmentary nevus. In this network, multi-branch lightweight units are used to extract rich and diverse ocular surface image feature maps, while channel shuffle operation enhances feature fusion between different branches, and nonlinear activation function H_swish is introduced to solve data collapse in model training. The experimental results show that our method achieves an average accuracy of 84.19% in the recognition of four classes ocular surface diseases, which has a marked improvement in both computational efficiency and classification accuracy compared with current lightweight networks. This not only improves the efficiency of automatic screening for ocular surface diseases, but also opens up new possibilities for deploying deep learning models on mobile devices.

articleTitle: A Deep Learning-Based Algorithm for Detecting Occluded Vehicles in Remote Sensing Images
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Computer Engineering (ICAICE)
abstract: In complex real-world traffic environments, vehicles are often obscured, which negatively impacts detection tasks and leads to a decrease in accuracy. To address this issue, this paper proposes an improved object detection algorithm based on YOLOv7, aimed at enhancing the network's ability to express the characteristics of the targets themselves and to resist external interference. Specifically, the algorithm replaces the convolutional layers in the head network and detection head of the Feature Pyramid Network with CoordConv; it also introduces the CBAM attention mechanism in the convolutional modules of the backbone network; finally, it uses DIoU to replace the CIoU loss function in the original model. Experimental results show that the proposed improved algorithm achieves a 1% increase in mAP@0.5 and a 4.7% increase in mAP@0.5:0.95 on the UCAS-AOD dataset. Overall, the algorithm enhances vehicle detection performance in remote sensing images while maintaining real-time capability.

articleTitle: Overview of Surveillance Video Compression for Power System
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Computer Engineering (ICAICE)
abstract: The video monitor system has been widely used in power systems, and with the rapid growth of video data, it poses enormous challenges for data storage and transmission. In response to the demand for efficient storage of video data in the power system, this paper first reviews traditional video data compression methods. In response to the inherent low information density feature of surveillance videos, this paper focuses on background compression based on background modeling and foreground encoding based on target structured expression. By using background modeling and structured representation of foreground targets, the compression efficiency of surveillance videos can be effectively improved, saving more storage space for power system video data.

articleTitle: High-Performance Sensing: Application of FPGA-based Winograd CNN Accelerator in Electronic Nose Systems
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Computer Engineering (ICAICE)
abstract: Electronic nose technology has been widely used in various scenarios such as industrial, military, food and environmental, and its recognition accelerator is responsible for completing the detection and identification of gases. Therefore, the application of advanced artificial intelligence algorithms to recognition accelerators is a common practice among researchers nowadays. However, neural networks with high recognition rates tend to have complex structures and a large number of parameters, which exacerbates the difficulty of deployment. To address this challenge, this paper first analyses and processes the detected gas data and proposes a hardware-friendly lightweight gas classification network, and then, based on this network, designs an FPGA-based Winograd CNN accelerator through the study of hardware implementation of Convolutional Neural Networks (CNN). The Winograd algorithm is used to reduce the number of multiplications used in the convolutional operation so as to reduce the consumption of hardware computing resources by the accelerator. Finally, the designed gas classification network is deployed on FPGA to complete the implementation of the recognition acceleration engine in the electronic nose system. The detection and recognition experiments on the laboratory gas dataset demonstrated good performance in terms of 99.5% recognition rate and only 2.94W power consumption of the accelerator, respectively.

articleTitle: Low-Resource Causal Relation Extraction with Semi-Supervised LLM Augmentation and Validation
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Computer Engineering (ICAICE)
abstract: Identifying causal relations in plain text is crucial for constructing knowledge graphs, as these relationships enhance our understanding of unstructured data. Traditional methods for causal relation extraction (CRE) often rely on large amounts of annotated data, which limits their effectiveness in real-world, data-scarce environments where noise and imbalance are prevalent. In this work, focusing on this problem, we propose a new approach that combines semi-supervised learning with large language models (LLMs) and incorporates validation to enhance the learning process. Particularly, our approach leverages LLMs to generate additional data and employs an iterative framework for dual validation. Evaluated across three datasets, our approach shows a significant 3% increase in F1 score. Additionally, in a low-resource setting using just 10% of the training data, we show that our approach achieves over a 5% improvement in F1 score compared to previous methods.

articleTitle: Fatigue Detection Based on Multiple Physiological Signals
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Computer Engineering (ICAICE)
abstract: Fatigue results from a series of physiological and psychological changes due to continuous energy consumption. It can affect the physiological states of operators, thereby reducing their labor capacity. Fatigue can also reduce efficiency and, in serious cases, cause severe accidents. In this study, a fatigue detection method based on deep CNN + Transformer is proposed by utilizing various physiological signals. Firstly, the time-frequency domain features of ECG signal, EEG signal, respiratory signal, skin electricity, skin temperature and other physiological signals were calculated to obtain the fatigue state characteristic matrix. By deep convolution and point-by-point convolution, the spatial features of physiological signals and the relationship between different channels are extracted, and the obtained multi-physiological signal feature vector is convolved with the extracted multi-physiological signal feature matrix to merge the features. Finally, by introducing residual connection and layer normalization technology after each sub-layer of Transformer encoder, the fatigue state detection results are output. The detection accuracy reached 89.27%, the recall rate was 78.01% and the F1-score was 83.37%.

articleTitle: The AOA-CNN-Attention-GRU Model for Predicting PM2.5 Concentration
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Computer Engineering (ICAICE)
abstract: A bstract-One of the key variables in determining air pollution indicators is PM<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2.5</inf> concentration, and accurate forecasting of PM<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2.5</inf> levels is essential for mitigating air pollution and protecting public health. However, currently, available PM<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2.5</inf> concentration prediction models are often simple combinations or single models. In this paper, a PM<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2.5</inf> concentration prediction model based on an AOA-CNN-Attention-GRU (ACAG) combined neural network is constructed by using the pollutant concentration, meteorological factors, and NDVI time-by-time data from 2019 to 2023 in Lanzhou City, combining AOA, attention mechanism, CNN and GRU. The findings indicate that the ACAG model has the greatest accuracy in making predictions when compared to the control model, with an RMSE of 7.937 <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\mu \mathrm{g}/\mathrm{m}^{3}$</tex>, an improvement of 13.6%~31.1%, an MAE of 3.329 <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\mu \mathrm{g}/\mathrm{m}^{3}$</tex>, an improvement of 32.7~57.7%, and an R2 of 0.936, an improvement in goodness-of-fit by 2.3%~7.5%. This demonstrates that compared to the comparison models, the ACAG model suggested in this research performs better in terms of prediction, and can effectively predict PM<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2.5</inf> concentration, to provide a scientific basis for environmental pollution control.

articleTitle: Deep Learning-Based Short-Term Heavy Rainfall Model
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Computer Engineering (ICAICE)
abstract: This study presents an Att-LSTM model based on a humidity threshold attention mechanism, applied to rainfall prediction in Wuhu, Anhui Province, with the aim of improving the accuracy of short-term heavy rainfall forecasts. The model combines the time series modeling capabilities of Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) networks and introduces a humidity threshold-guided attention mechanism, which enhances the model's focus on critical time steps when humidity values exceed a preset threshold through a weighting mechanism. Comparative experimental results show that the attention model incorporating the humidity threshold exhibits higher accuracy and better stability in rainfall period identification and heavy rainfall prediction compared to the traditional LSTM model. The humidity threshold-based attention mechanism allows the model to adapt more flexibly to sudden weather events, ensuring that rainfall predictions align more closely with actual weather patterns. The findings indicate that the humidity threshold mechanism can effectively enhance the performance of rainfall prediction models, providing new technical support for improving meteorological forecasting accuracy and disaster prevention.

articleTitle: Research on Turnout Fault Diagnosis Model Based on GADF-CNN-MAML
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Computer Engineering (ICAICE)
abstract: As a crucial component in the railway transportation system, the implementation of regular maintenance and fault detection on turnout equipment not only prevents potential operational risks but also ensures the smooth operation of the railway network. Currently, intelligent fault diagnosis for turnouts is mostly based on deep learning models, which possess strong capabilities for fault signal feature extraction and accurate identification. However, under conditions of scarcity in fault data, the performance of these models declines, resulting in low diagnostic accuracy. To address the shortcomings of these models, this paper leverages the advantages of meta-learning algorithms in addressing small-sample issues and focuses on the power curve of the ZD7 turnout switch machine. It applies the Model-Agnostic Meta-Learning (MAML) algorithm to Convolutional Neural Networks (CNN) and employs Gramian Angular Difference Field (GADF) encoding to convert the one-dimensional time-series power curve of the turnout switch machine into two-dimensional feature maps. A turnout fault diagnosis model based on GADF-CNN-MAML is proposed, and experiments have verified that this model effectively improves the accuracy of fault diagnosis.

articleTitle: Application of CNN and its Fusion Model in Concrete Crack Detection Modeling
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Computer Engineering (ICAICE)
abstract: The objective of this study is to assess the feasibility of employing convolutional neural networks (CNNs) for the detection of cracks on concrete surfaces and to evaluate their efficacy in enhancing recognition precision and other critical performance indicators. Using a database of 30,000 concrete surface images, this study systematically evaluated the performance of five mainstream convolutional neural network models - VGG16, DenseNet121, ResNet50V2, EfficientNetB0, and MobileNet - on this dataset. Based on the initial performance evaluation, researchers further constructed multiple fusion models with the aim of optimizing the recognition performance through model fusion strategies, focusing on the more efficient ones. Furthermore, to assess the Robustness of the models under the condition of restricted sample size, the study also performed sample reduction on the dataset and carried out the corresponding robustness analysis.

articleTitle: A New Optimization Method to Real Time Streaming Protocol
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Computer Engineering (ICAICE)
abstract: This paper introduces a new optimization to the Real Time Streaming Protocol. Our optimization expounds the basic concepts, working principle and application scenarios of RTSP, and introduces the core idea of NSGA-II algorithm and its application in multi-objective optimization. Our optimization can solve the problem of delay, bandwidth shortage and data loss in RTSP-transmission. The experimental results show the significant advantage of our strategy under high packet loss rate and low bandwidth conditions. The results proved the importance of our strategy, which can improve the transmission efficiency and user experience of real-time streaming media, and discusses research limitations and future directions, such as optimizing algorithm parameters or integrating new technologies.

articleTitle: The Research Focuses on the Classification and Recognition of Speech Imagery EEG Signals Based on a Fusion Network Autoencoder
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Computer Engineering (ICAICE)
abstract: Electroencephalogram (EEG) signals present significant challenges in processing and analysis due to their low signal-to-noise ratio, nonlinearity, and non-stationarity. Traditional feature extraction methods struggle to effectively capture the complex spatiotemporal patterns inherent in EEG signals. In recent years, various deep learning frameworks have demonstrated excellent performance in decoding electroencephalogram (EEG) signals. However, most frameworks tend to focus on unidimensional features, making it challenging to effectively integrate spatial and temporal characteristics. This paper proposes a model structure that integrates a fusion network based on CNN and LSTM embedded within an autoencoder. The CNN is used to extract spatial features from the EEG signals, while the LSTM is employed to capture the temporal dependencies and dynamic patterns of the signals. By embedding the CNN+LSTM fusion network within the autoencoder, the model can learn and represent the complex spatiotemporal dependency features of EEG signals. Experiments conducted on the imagined speech dataset from Track #3 of the 2020 International BCI Competition demonstrate that the proposed model exhibits significant advantages in feature extraction compared to existing models, particularly in classification tasks. The model achieves classification accuracies of 92.49% for binary one-vs-many classification and 69.01% for five-class classification.

articleTitle: Determination of Calorific Value in Coal Using Laser-Induced Breakdown Spectroscopy Combined with Machine Learning Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Computer Engineering (ICAICE)
abstract: Rapid analysis of calorific value is of great significance for the efficient and clean application of coal. In this work, laser induced breakdown spectroscopy (LIBS) coupled with different machine learning method was employed to analyze calorific value in coal. Principal component regression (PCR) algorithm, partial least squares regression (PLSR) algorithm, and support vector machine regression (SVR) algorithm were used to establish analysis models separately. The pretreatment methods and important model parameters were investigated to improve predictive performance of models. Compared with PCR and SVR, PLSR method exhibited superior predictive performance when the spectral data was preprocessed with standard normal transformation and the number of latent variable was set to 15. For the PLSR model, the root mean square error of prediction set (RMSEP) was 1.0010, and the correlation coefficient of prediction set (R<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">p</inf>) was 0.9734. The results show that LIBS coupled with PLSR is a potential method for rapid analysis of calorific value in coal.

articleTitle: Multi View Real-Time Control Method of Mechanical Arm for Live Working in Substation Based on SIFT Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Computer Engineering (ICAICE)
abstract: The conventional real-time control method of mechanical arm establishes the coordinate system on each joint. The control method is too complex to meet the real-time requirements. Therefore, a multi view real-time control method based on SIFT algorithm is designed for the double manipulator of substation live working. The SIFT algorithm is used to match the multi view real-time control feature points of the live working mechanical arm, extract the feature points from the image of each view, and determine the relative position and attitude of the manipulator under different views through the matching between the feature points. Generates the real-time steady-state control rate of the live working mechanical arm in the substation from multiple perspectives, and generates the steady-state control rate according to the real-time feedback status information of the manipulator, so as to ensure that the manipulator can maintain a stable operating state during operation and avoid unnecessary vibration and deviation. The simulation experiment proves that the real-time control effect of this method is better and can be applied in real life.

articleTitle: Deep Learning Seismic Detection on Fixed-Point Deformation Data: A Case in Tianjin, China
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Computer Engineering (ICAICE)
abstract: Seismic detection of fixed-point deformation data currently relies on manual identification, and no automated detection method has yet been put into application. In this paper, we propose the first deep learning model for seismic detection of fixed-point deformation data, which is used to detect seismic signals quickly and accurately on VP broadband tiltmeter seconds data in Tianjin, China. The model uses a transfer learning technique that introduces three representative seismometer data seismic detection pretrained models as feature extractors, and redesigns the data input layer of the model by transferring the knowledge and capabilities of these models for seismic detection on seismometer data to fixed-point deformation data. Tests on real fixed-point deformation data show that our model has good detection performance, and the application on continuous fixed-point deformation data in Tianjin proves that the model is able to effectively identify a large number of seismic events missed by manual identification, with an accuracy of not less than 75%, and the detection efficiency and accuracy have been greatly improved compared with manual processing.

articleTitle: Forecasting Shanghai Containerized Freight Index by CPO-VMD-PE-ELM Model
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Computer Engineering (ICAICE)
abstract: Accurate forecasting of freight rate index can provide decision-making basis for shipping market practitioners. To improve the prediction accuracy of container freight index, this paper takes Shanghai Containerized Freight Index (SCFI) as the research object and constructs a forecasting framework combining decomposition algorithm and machine learning model. Firstly, SCFI is decomposed into Intrinsic Mode Function (IMF) using Crested Porcupine Optimizer (CPO) optimized Variational Mode Decomposition (VMD) model. Secondly, IMFs with approximate entropy values are merged according to the idea of Permutation Entropy (PE) to reduce the computational scale; finally, IMFs are predicted separately using Extreme Learning Machine (ELM) model, and their prediction results are superimposed as the final prediction results of SCFI. The empirical analysis results show that the model constructed in this paper has high forecasting accuracy and robustness and can provide a new technical reference for container freight index forecasting.

articleTitle: Research on Intelligent Traffic Pedestrian Detection Algorithm Based on Improved YOLOv8
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Computer Engineering (ICAICE)
abstract: Aiming at the problem of poor detection of long-distance pedestrians in intelligent traffic scenarios, an improved YOLOv8 pedestrian detection algorithm is proposed. Using YOLOv8 as the basic network, SPD-Conv is embedded before the C2f layer of backbone and after the Conv layer of neck as the key preprocessing step. Experimental results on the public dataset Caltech Pedestrian Dataset show that compared with the baseline algorithm, mAP0.5 is increased by 3%, mAP0.5: 0.95 is increased by 5.8%, and LAMR is reduced by 5.5%. Compared with the popular algorithm, mAP0.5 and mAP0.5: 0.95 are as high as 0.892 and 0.598, respectively, and LAMR is as low as 0.249, which is better than the popular algorithm. The results show that the algorithm achieves a significant improvement in accuracy in pedestrian detection tasks, and effectively reduces the occurrence of missed detection. It can serve intelligent transportation more effectively and reduce the potential safety hazards caused by missed detection.

articleTitle: A Knowledge Distillation Strategy with Multi-Prompt Learning for Aspect-Based Sentiment Analysis
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Computer Engineering (ICAICE)
abstract: Aspect-based sentiment analysis (ABSA) is a crucial area within natural language processing that focuses on determining the sentiment polarity of specific aspect terms in sentences. Traditional deep learning methods for ABSA often face challenges to capture the diverse semantic nuances of different texts in low-resource scenarios due to their reliance on the data scale. In this paper, we introduce a novel multi-prompt learning framework enhanced by knowledge distillation to overcome these limitations. Our approach utilizes multiple prompts to fully leverage the implicit knowledge they share, thereby enhancing sentiment classification performance, especially in few-shot settings. We implement this method using the T5 pre-trained model, creating a basic multi-prompt network complemented by a knowledge distillation process that iteratively updates model parameters by treating the outputs from various prompts as soft labels. Extensive experiments on the SemEval 2014 datasets (14-Laptop and 14-Restaurant) reveal significant improvements in F1-score compared to existing state-of-the-art methods, particularly in low-resource contexts. Our findings highlight the effectiveness of combining multi-prompt learning with knowledge distillation in advancing aspect-level sentiment classification.

articleTitle: Region Target Tracking and Counting Method Based on YOLOv5 and DeepSORT
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Computer Engineering (ICAICE)
abstract: For the multi-target tracking and counting task in the region, YOLOv5 and DeepSORT algorithms are used to improve the detection performance of YOLOv5 algorithm by improving the loss function and non-maximum suppression. IOU is used to better measure the motion characteristics during multi-target tracking. The algorithm has good performence and can effectively detect targets and track them stably. The model can be deployed and tested on embedded device, meeting the requirements for tracking and counting targets in the area, and providing time prompts for specific entry direction markers.

articleTitle: A Perception Method of Direct Sequence Spreading Spectrum Signal Based on an Improved Residual Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Computer Engineering (ICAICE)
abstract: The problem of detecting spreading-spectrum signals under non-cooperative conditions has always been a hot research topic in the field of communication countermeasures. Traditional detection methods have poor performance at low signal-to-noise ratios. To effectively improve the performance of spread-spectrum signal detection, a spread-spectrum signal detection method based on an improved residual neural network is proposed. First, the correlation peak characteristics of the spread-spectrum signal are quickly extracted by the generalized cross-correlation algorithm. Then, the residual neural network is used as the basis, and the attention mechanism is integrated to establish the network model and analyze and identify abstract features. Finally, the proposed method is experimentally verified on a simulated data set. The results show that compared with the time-domain autocorrelation method, the convolutional neural network method, etc., the proposed method has better detection effect and can effectively detect spread-spectrum signals at a signal-to-noise ratio of -16 dB.

articleTitle: Power Grid Transient Stability Assessment Method Based on Big Data Analysis
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Computer Engineering (ICAICE)
abstract: In this paper, traditional causal analysis method and big data analysis method are integrated to propose a method to perform power grid transient stability assessment based on causal analysis results for building a sample database and big data analysis. Firstly, transient stability modes are extracted from massive historical quantitative analysis or simulation calculation results according to faults and take union set of the stability modes of all faults as key feature variables. Secondly, the faults are clustered according to the feature variables to generate a power grid transient stability assessment knowledge base. Finally, carry out automatic matching and power grid transient stability assessment based on the knowledge base for multiple faults under current mode. Meanwhile, knowledge iteration is conducted by comparing with the results of causal analysis method. This method improves calculation speed of power grid transient stability assessment, provides a basis for power grid safety and stability rapid decision-making and a new idea for analyzing power grid transient safety and stability.

articleTitle: Prediction of Burn-Through Point in Sintering Process Based on Improved Hybrid Optimization Algorithm and TCN-BiGRU-AM
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Computer Engineering (ICAICE)
abstract: Sintering is a crucial upstream process in the steelmaking process, and accurately predicting the burning through point (BTP) is vital for the yield and quality of sintered ore. The rise of artificial intelligence and deep learning has introduced innovative data-driven methods for predicting the BTP. In this paper, we propose a model that combines Temporal Convolutional Network (TCN), Bidirectional Gated Recurrent Unit (BiGRU), and Attention mechanism to predict the sintering end point. Before training the model, we employ an innovative Improved Grey Wolf Optimizer-Whale Optimization Algorithm (IGWO-WOA) to find the optimal hyperparameters for the model. To validate the proposed method, we conduct experiments using actual production data from a steel company, comparing the proposed model with pre-improvement algorithms and single models. The results indicate that the proposed method has good prediction accuracy, with a Mean Absolute Error (MAE) of 0.0306 and a Root Mean Square Error (RMSE) of 0.0619, confirming the effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Text-Driven Image Inpainting with Cross Attention Control
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Computer Engineering (ICAICE)
abstract: With the development of text-to-image generative models, text-conditioned image editing has become a powerful tool in the realm of image manipulation. In this paper, we focus on the removal of unwanted objects from images. In conventional methods, removing objects often requires manually inputting masks and leaves visible traces at the boundaries with the original image. To avoid the aforementioned scenario, we decide to modify the attention maps during the image generation process only using the inputting prompt, thereby generating a flawless image. We perform similarity calculations on all attention maps. Based on these computations, we modify the attention maps to ensure that the target image not only perfectly removes the object but also keeps the remaining parts unchanged. Throughout our research, we also examined how changes in the values of the cross-attention maps affect the objects in the image, and the time points during diffusion when objects can determine their spatial information. More importantly, our method doesn't require training, enabling image editing to be accomplished in a short period.

articleTitle: An Automatic Question and Answer Method for Hybrid Strategy of Electric Power Customer Service Based on Multi-Dimensional Features
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Computer Engineering (ICAICE)
abstract: In the field of electric customer service, with the increase and expansion of customer service business scenarios and the expansion of business scope, intelligent customer service relying on manual formulation of automatic response rules can only meet a small number of user needs, resulting in increased pressure on customer service personnel. In order to solve this problem, an automatic question and answer method for electric power customer service hybrid strategy based on multidimensional features is presented, which fully integrates user semantics and business knowledge information, integrating hybrid strategies to improve question answering accuracy. Search recall is responsible for recalling relevant knowledge from a massive knowledge base based on sentence vectors and knowledge texts. Integrated Q&A is responsible for synthesizing multidimensional features to explore user potential intentions as much as possible, thus achieving high-precision and high scalability question answering models. The experimental results show that the Q&A model based on multidimensional features is applicable to the accurate Q&A of power customer service and has practical value.

articleTitle: FM-GAN: A Novel Algorithm Based Data Generation Methodfor Rolling Bearings Under Imbalanced Samples
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Computer Engineering (ICAICE)
abstract: The scarcity of fault samples affects classification accuracy seriously in rotating equipment monitoring. To address data imbalance, this paper proposes a Fourier transform and Multi-head attention optimized Generative Adversarial Network (FM-GAN). The generator, enhanced with multi-head attention, generates signals that are co-optimized with the original signals. Fourier transform is then applied to obtain the real and imaginary parts of the signals for further refinement. Experiments show that the samples generated by FM-GAN are highly integrated with actual data in terms of feature representation and classification performance, effectively addressing the issue of data imbalance.

articleTitle: Research on Deaf-Mute People Translation System Based on Natural Language Processing
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Computer Engineering (ICAICE)
abstract: Sign language is a vital mode of communication for deaf individuals, yet it frequently proves challenging to convey messages to hearing people. The preceding two-way interaction system was found to be ineffective. Furthermore, convolutional neural network-based devices are also susceptible to interference in complex environments, which affects the recognition effect. The objective of the model proposed in this work is to address the communication barriers between deaf-mute and hearing-friendly people, primarily through the utilisation of sign language interpretation. The initial stage of the process involved the utilisation of a convolutional neural network (CNN) to facilitate gesture recognition, capture the intricate details of sign language actions, and integrate deep learning methodologies to extract the distinctive features of gesture images. Subsequently, a natural language processing model is employed to combine the visual features with the language model, thereby facilitating accurate translation from sign language to spoken language. To enhance recognition capabilities in complex settings, the system employs multimodal data fusion technology, integrating gesture actions and contextual semantic data to bolster the reliability and precision of translation. The experimental analysis demonstrates that the model exhibits high accuracy and efficiency in translation and interaction across a range of scenarios.

articleTitle: A Compressed Post-Processing Algorithm for Online Data Detection Model Based on Knowledge Distillation
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Computer Engineering (ICAICE)
abstract: This paper puts forward a compressed post-processing algorithm for the online data detection model based on knowledge distillation. By employing a new model to purify the eigenvalue of the input original image. The online detection model for the surface quality of workpieces is trained. The scaling factor in the BN layer is utilized to conduct sparse training of the local network space. And both channel simplify and layer simplify are carried out on the sparse model. YOLOV4 lacks the accuracy of location detection and identification is enhanced, and the autoregressive processing of compressed data is improved through the online data detection algorithm based on knowledge distillation. The simulation results indicate that without the knowledge distillation method, the optimal accuracy of the model is 96.05% after 100 iterations, which is 1.29% lower than that before compression. After 90 passes, the accuracy of the model attains 97.41%, which is essentially in line with that before compression. The end of tests reveal that the model condensing can accurately simplify the accuracy of model and guarantee the accuracy for the surface quality of workpieces.

articleTitle: Research on Tibetan Verb Character Recognition Based on Bert Model
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Computer Engineering (ICAICE)
abstract: The traditional recognition methods of Tibetan verbs are mainly based on rule matching and statistical features,however,these methods are often limited by the complex structure of Tibetan language, rules are not fixed and other factors,the accuracy rate is low and the generalization ability is limited. The two-way information of the input text is taken into account in the coding process of Bert model, which avoids the loss of one-way information in the traditional model. By the Bert model,we have realized the accurate recognition of Tibetan verbs. The experimental results show that our method has a significant improvement on the recognition of verb error character, the accuracy and generalization ability are significantly improved compared with the traditional methods. The results of this study provide new ideas and methods for the research and application of Tibetan text processing and contribute to the development of Tibetan natural language processing technology.

articleTitle: Optimization of Deck Barge Fleet Stowage Based on an Intelligent Optimization Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Computer Engineering (ICAICE)
abstract: A multi-constraint mathematical model for the optimization problem is established in addressing the deck barge fleet stowage optimization problem for large-scale cargoes. A novel encoding scheme is proposed to enable the optimization algorithm to tackle the problem. The established mathematical model is solved using a Gray Wolf Optimizer (GWO) enhanced by differential evolution (DE), termed GWO-DE. According to the basic principle of “the goods that arrive at the port first are loaded later” in the actual loading process, a two-stage surplus rectangular method is introduced to generate the stowage plan of each voyage. Comparative simulation examples substantiate the superiority of GWO-DE in addressing stowage optimization for deck barge fleets, with the derived stowage plans offering a valuable reference for manual decision-making and enhancing decision-making efficiency.

articleTitle: Traffic Sign Recognition in Rainy, Snowy and Foggy Weather Based on Improved YOLOv8
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Computer Engineering (ICAICE)
abstract: To address the issue of poor performance in traffic sign recognition technology during adverse weather conditions like rain, snow, and fog, this paper presents an enhanced YOLOv8 model. This model excels in enhancing the accuracy of traffic sign recognition, significantly outperforming the original YOLOv8 in terms of performance. We optimized the model's Neck section by substituting the original PANet with a Weighted Bidirectional Feature Pyramid Network (BiFPN), thereby bolstering the model's feature fusion capabilities. Additionally, we incorporated a Global Attention Mechanism (GAM) into the Neck region to precisely adjust attention during the crucial feature fusion phase, further elevating detection accuracy. Compared to the original YOLOv8 model, our improved model exhibits a 4% increase in the mean Average Precision (mAP) score, facilitating more precise detection of traffic signs.

articleTitle: Temporal Knowledge Graph Completion Based on Temporal Dependency and Commonsense Guidance
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Computer Engineering (ICAICE)
abstract: The Temporal Knowledge Graph (TKG) extends traditional knowledge graphs by introducing a temporal dimension, but the challenges of temporal dependency and sequential characteristics make completion and prediction more difficult. Existing methods for Temporal Knowledge Graph Completion (TKGC) often struggle to simultaneously consider the temporal dependency of events and the consistency of common sense, which limits their reasoning effectiveness. To address this issue, this paper proposes a new model, TDCGC. This model combines a Temporal Transformer with an innovative temporal dependency rule learning algorithm, utilizing predicate embedding regularization guided by temporal dependency rules along with Temporal Transformer for temporal modeling. The Temporal Transformer effectively captures the temporal dependencies between events, while the commonsense-based time-invariant representations are used to score events. Moreover, the model can effectively capture complex temporal interactions between events by delving deeply into the long-term dependencies of time series, thereby enhancing the completion capabilities of the knowledge graph. Experimental results show that this model improves the Mean Reciprocal Rank (MRR) by 1.1% and 1.2% on the ICEWS14 and ICEWS05-15 datasets, respectively, demonstrating a significant enhancement in its adaptability and reasoning ability when handling temporal-dependent data.

articleTitle: Functional Gradient Plate Intrinsic Frequency Analysis Based on Fitting Deviation Optimization Physical Information Neural Networks
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Computer Engineering (ICAICE)
abstract: Aiming at the difficulty of solving the heat frequency control equation and the problem of boundary data points amplifying neural network bias, this paper proposes a fitting deviation optimization physical information neural network (FDO-PINN) for solving the intrinsic frequency of three-dimensional functional gradient plates in a thermal environment. An function is given to fit the neural network training data, then the training data is gradually sliced from the outside and its fitting error is calculated, and the data region with the smallest fitting error is found to be the physical solution region of the control equations. In this paper, an experimental simulation analysis of the comsol data is carried out, and the results show that the FDO-PINN is able to solve the problem of solving the intrinsic frequency in the thermal environment of the functional gradient plate, and the highest solving error is only 1.56% when the test temperature exceeds the training temperature by 100 degrees. The average error within the training temperature is only 0.62%.

articleTitle: Semi-Supervised Subspace Clustering Based on Tensor Low-Rank Representation with Weighted Tensor Schatten-p Norm
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Computer Engineering (ICAICE)
abstract: In this paper, semi-supervised subspace clustering based on tensor low-rank representation is proposed to do the clustering task. In our paper, we propose to use the weighted tensor Schatten-p norm to approximate tensor multi-rank. Besides,we adjust the data structure of the tensor model to reduce the computational time of t-SVD in our method to improve the computational efficiency. Eventually, experimental results demonstrate that our method outperforms other methods and the running time is much shorter than those methods.

articleTitle: Integrated Detection of Coarse-Grained Ship Trajectory Anomalies Based on Trajectory Clustering
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Computer Engineering (ICAICE)
abstract: For ship trajectory anomaly detection, this paper proposes a coarse-grained multi-anomaly real-time integrated detection method with trajectory clustering as the basis of normal model establishment, taking ship trajectory in local sea area as the analysis object. In the stage of ship normal behavior model establishment, the anti-noise performance of the density-based clustering algorithm and the high efficiency of the grid-based clustering algorithm and its anti-noise performance are utilized to complete the modeling of the ship trajectory normal behavioral pattern, and the ship trajectory based on the position points is transformed into the symbolic trajectory based on the sequence of hotspot areas; then, four kinds of trajectory anomalies are defined by combining the trajectory motion features and semantic features, and the detection of the four kinds of anomalies is completed within the same detection Then, four kinds of trajectory anomalies are defined by combining the trajectory motion features and semantic features, and the real-time integrated detection of the four kinds of anomalies is accomplished within the same detection framework. The experimental results prove the effectiveness of the detection method.

articleTitle: Research on Network Data Anomaly Detection Method Under Zero Trust Model
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Computer Engineering (ICAICE)
abstract: The network data anomaly detection technology under the Zero Trust model can predict whether the network traffic is normal and provide services for monitoring new network attacks and anomalies. This article proposes a machine learning method based on multi-feature combination under the Zero Trust model, by analyzing traffic characteristics and removing redundant traffic features. The experimental results show that the accuracy of CNN algorithm in detecting traffic anomalies based on multiple features can reach over 97%, demonstrating the feasibility of the proposed method in this article.

articleTitle: HA-YOLO: A Real-Time Method for Detecting Surface Defects in Steel
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Computer Engineering (ICAICE)
abstract: In the field of energy transmission, surface defect detection of steel is an important issue. However, traditional defect detection methods have some problems, such as lack of feature extraction ability, slow detection speed, and poor detection performance. A new network HA-YOLO based on YOLO v10 has been proposed to address the aforementioned issues. Firstly, some convolution layers in the backbone network are modified to AKConv, allowing the shape and position of the convolution kernel to be dynamically adjusted according to the image content, better matching and covering the object area, and obtaining stronger feature extraction capabilities with lower parameter costs. In addition, a new attention module HAM has been designed, which embeds location information into channel attention to obtain long-range dependence while retaining accurate location information, and is lightweight enough. Finally, extensive experimental results have shown that on the NEU-DET dataset, the mAP of HA-YOLO reaches 75.1%, the inference time is 5.1ms, and the number of model parameters is reduced to 2.51M. Compared with YOLOv10, mAP increased by 5.9% and mAP<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">50-90</inf> increased by 4.4%, proving that this model has excellent comprehensive performance in steel surface defect detection.

articleTitle: Research on the Influencing Factors and Crime Prediction of Drug Crimes Based on Decision Tree Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Computer Engineering (ICAICE)
abstract: This research aims to design and develop a decision tree model to achieve drug crime prediction in border ethnic minority areas. This study will build on previous research by examining the extent to which four different types of factors - occupation, permanent population, age, and education level - can explain drug crimes in border ethnic minority areas in 2014 and 2021. The data comes from a sample of 1,856 drug crimes. This study uses the decision tree method to reveal that drug crimes are related to occupation, permanent population, age, and education level, while ethnic identity in border ethnic minority areas is not the only factor related to drug crimes. These results show that the new framework model introduced in this study can better explain drug crimes. The research findings have important practical implications, as they show that targeting these four factors in anti-drug crime policies is crucial.

articleTitle: A Radar Degradation Fault Data Forecast Method Based on Dynamic Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Computer Engineering (ICAICE)
abstract: Traditional radar degradation fault data forecast has some drawbacks, such as large training data, manual feature extraction, and low forecast accuracy. Therefore, a radar degradation fault data forecast method based on dynamic neural network is proposed. This method can dynamically forecast the peak power measurement data of radar and achieve high-precision forecast of radar degradation fault data. The experimental results show that the root mean square error of the data forecast proposed in this paper is 0.627 kW lower than that of traditional neural network data forecast, and can accurately forecast radar degradation fault data with small samples and no feature extraction.

articleTitle: The Research and Analysis of Robust Image Steganography for Arbitrary Style Transfer
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Computer Engineering (ICAICE)
abstract: The use of deep learning technology has notably improved the performance of image steganography. However, current methods are lacking in stylized environments and require retraining of the steganography model for each specific style, resulting in high training costs, limited applications, and low effectiveness in anti-steganalysis. To address these issues, a robust method for image steganography in arbitrary style transfer is proposed. This method introduces an arbitrary stylization model and a residual module with enhanced structural loss. Initially, an image preprocessing module aligns sizes and fuses features of the input cover image and secret image. Subsequently, the feature extraction ability of the encoder-decoder-based steganography model is further enhanced by the introduction of two-layer residual blocks. Finally, the attention-based arbitrary stylization network and structural loss are utilized to optimize the network training of the steganography model, achieving effective embedding and decryption of the secret image in the context of arbitrary stylization. Experimental analysis demonstrates that the proposed method can achieve an SSIM of 0.91, a PSNR of 28.11, and a BER of 0.07 between the input secret image and the decrypted output. The stylized steganographic (stego) images exhibit improved visual quality and are visually more difficult to detect for embedded traces compared to the original stego image. The use of the YeNet model for steganalysis on stylized stego images yields a detection accuracy as low as 42.33%, about 26% lower than before stylization, significantly reducing the risk of discovering steganographic information. Therefore, the proposed method can achieve more effective steganography for arbitrary stylization, with enhanced scalability, imperceptibility, and anti-steganalysis capabilities.

articleTitle: A Method for Modeling Employee Portraits in State-Owned Enterprises Based on Artificial Intelligence and its Application
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Computer Engineering (ICAICE)
abstract: Talent development is a crucial factor for the development of enterprises and units. This article uses data analysis models and data mining techniques to help enterprises and institutions analyze talent data, discover outstanding talents, and construct talent models. Firstly, collect and match employee data, appointment and dismissal materials, investigation materials, and other information from the human resources management system of a state-owned enterprise. Use data processing technology to clean the raw data, perform text segmentation, and extract professional domain features from employee domain information. Then, use LDA topic model to classify the processed information data into professional domain topic categories, and combine ontology methods with relevant concepts in the ontology library to construct an employee portrait label system, form employee talent portraits, and obtain personal labels; And through machine learning classification algorithms such as SVM, LightGBM, XGBoost, etc., the application scenarios of employee talent portraits were explained. Combined with the appointment and removal of cadres and the frequency of personal labels, feature dimensionality reduction was carried out to obtain important features for cadre promotion, which contributed to the selection of cadres for enterprises.

articleTitle: Exploration of Innovative Imputation Techniques for Missing Data in Multivariate Time Series
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Computer Engineering (ICAICE)
abstract: Currently, when conducting research in the area of time series, the problem of missing data is often encountered, which brings trouble to our research work. In this paper, we propose a Joint Attention Imputation(JAI) model based on the self-attention mechanism, aiming to improve the accuracy of data imputation. JAI learns the feature values through the joint optimization training method of interpolation and reconstruction. On the other hand, through the two-layered attention mechanism, the temporal dependence and feature correlation between steps and the cross-latitude dependence can be explicitly captured. Dependence and feature correlation between steps and cross-latitude dependence. Experiments show that JAI significantly outperforms existing mainstream models in performing data imputation, demonstrating its powerful imputation capability and application potential.

articleTitle: A Study on Bird Calls Recognition Method for Overhead Lines Integrating CNN Models
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Computer Engineering (ICAICE)
abstract: The safe and stable operation of overhead lines is fundamental to societal production and daily life. Currently, the bird deterrent devices for overhead lines are primarily mechanical structures, which are unable to reliably complete the task of bird damage monitoring. With the rapid advancement of voice recognition technology, it has become feasible to use various sensors to collect image and voice data around overhead lines and to distinguish bird species using recognition algorithms. In this study, two common bird species in the South China region, sparrows and Asian koels, were selected as identification targets. The designed bird monitoring device differentiates between bird calls and environmental noise, specifically recognizing these bird species. In natural environment testing, the device was able to accurately distinguish bird calls from background noise, with a classification accuracy exceeding 80% for both bird species.

articleTitle: AFN-YOLO: Adaptive Frequency Network for SAR Ship Detection in Complex Inshore Background
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Computer Engineering (ICAICE)
abstract: In recent years, object detection methods based on deep learning have been widely used for ship detection by synthetic aperture radar (SAR). However, complex backgrounds with similar textures of buildings and ships significantly affect the SAR ship detection performance. Inspired by the frequency-domain texture information that can highlight the texture difference between the target and its background, this paper proposes a new deep learning network, AFN-YOLO, to suppress the interference of the inshore complex background on ship detection, which can adaptively extract the frequency-domain texture information that distinguishes between the target and the background of the ship. AFTM (Adaptive Fourier Transform Module) converts spatial information into frequency domain information and adaptively fuses spatial domain information. Lastly, we propose Adaptive CIoU, ACIoU to increase the ability to adapt to all kinds of special cases in the complex inshore background, to accelerate the model convergence, and to improve the model's performance. AFN-YOLO is evaluated on two datasets, the SAR Ship Detection Dataset (SSDD) and High-Resolution SAR images dataset (HRSID), and achieves the state-of-the-art detection performance on both datasets compared to the baseline method YOLOv8 and the current representative methods.

articleTitle: LDA-UNet: A Lightweight UNet with Multi-Dimensional Selective Attention for Efficient Skin Lesion Segmentation
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Computer Engineering (ICAICE)
abstract: Different UNet models do well in tasks like semantic segmentation. Yet, these models still do not use detailed features enough and have weak global feature understanding. UNet links the encoder and decoder with skip connections. This lets the decoder get detailed info from the encoder, which helps the model work better. But having skip connections for just one set of encoder and decoder is not enough to use all the multi-level detailed features. Plus, UNet builds the encoder and decoder with convolution methods. Because convolutional operations have a small view of the data, the model's ability to understand the whole set of data is still low. To solve the problems of weak feature use and poor overall modeling, we suggest a simple fix: a light Multi-Dimensional Selective Attention Enhanced UNet (LDA-UNet). To get around the small view of the UNet design, we add the Multi-Dimensional Selective Attention Block. This part boosts the model's global skill and widens the view while using fewer parameters. To fix the issue of low use of multi-level features, we use a multi-level skip connection method. This helps the decoder reach features at different sizes and improves detail capture. We tested the model on the ISIC-2018 dataset, and the results show that, when compared to other methods, this algorithm does a better job at segmentation while using fewer parameters.

articleTitle: Artificial Intelligence-Based Computational Analysis and Optimization of Civil Engineering Structures
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Computer Engineering (ICAICE)
abstract: This paper examines the possibility of artificial intelligence (AI) approaches for the computational representation of civil engineering structures, with specific attention paid to prediction of reinforced concrete beam capacity. A comparative study of Deep Neural Networks (DNN) and traditional Finite Element Analysis (FEM), Support Vector Machines (SVM) in dimension jump for computational efficiency and predictive accuracy The experimental results show that DNN is the best choice for resolving such complicated nonlinear problems as well as multidimensional features, showing the R2 and MSE of 0.92 and 0.025 respectively, while the computation time is just about only 1/10 compared to FEM. Although AI models present remarkable efficiency and accuracy, drawbacks like data dependency and lack of model interpretability are still there. This paper presents the highest level of effort in improving data quality, optimization on feature selection, and a more general approach to exposing AI-based models embedded inside the structural computational model with accompanying physics-informed AI that can strengthen its application in structural computation. Future research will focus on multi-source data integration, advanced model optimization, and intelligent engineering applications, contributing to the digital transformation of civil engineering.

articleTitle: FL-RDGRU: A Federal Learning Traffic Flow Prediction Without Memory Loss
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Computer Engineering (ICAICE)
abstract: Most current traffic flow prediction approaches use machine learning or simple deep learning models, necessitating centralized data storage. Moreover, the simplistic structure of deep learning models significantly impacts prediction accuracy and stability generated by the selection of training data and overfitting problem. While dropout regularization is used to mitigate overfitting in neural networks, it may compromise the network's ability to retain long-term information. To address these shortcomings,we propose a scheme based on Federated Learning (FL-RDGRU) for traffic flow prediction.

articleTitle: Design and Verification of 1553B Communication Interface Based on SoC Chip
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Computer Engineering (ICAICE)
abstract: The 1553B bus is widely used in airborne equipment due to its remarkable real-time performance and reliability. With the rapid advancement of China's science and technology and aerospace industry, more and more airborne equipment is developing in the direction of miniaturisation and convenience, based on this, integration has become the trend of SoC chip design, this paper designs a 1553B communication interface module based on SoC chip, through the specific design and analysis of SoC chip and interface module, and verifies the function of the whole system, the results show that 1553B communication interface software and hardware can efficiently interact with data, In the 1553B communication system, the data transmission and receiving state is normal, which provides a strong support for the development of airborne networks in the direction of portability.

articleTitle: Study of Lithium Battery Charge State Estimation Based on Improved Particle Filtering Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Computer Engineering (ICAICE)
abstract: Lithium batteries are extensively used across industries for clean energy applications. However, their capacity degrades over time, resulting in diminished performance and potential safety concerns. Accurate estimation of the state of charge (SOC) is essential for effective battery management. In this paper, a SOC estimation method based on the 2RC-PNGV equivalent circuit model is proposed for SOC estimation in lithium batteries, integrating an improved particle filtering algorithm to enhance estimation accuracy. The model accounts for deviation behavior during charging and discharging, and offline parameter identification is achieved using the variable forgetting factor recursive least squares method. Additionally, two advanced particle filtering algorithms—extended Kalman filter-enhanced particle filtering (EPF) and unscented Kalman filter-enhanced particle filtering (UPF)—are introduced. The particle posterior probability densities are updated differently to improve estimation accuracy. Experimental results indicate that SOC estimation errors for EPF and UPF algorithms are limited to 0.6% and 0.3%, respectively, under dynamic stress test (DST) conditions. The UPF algorithm demonstrates strong accuracy and robustness under complex conditions. This study presents an innovative solution for SOC estimation, contributing to enhanced safety and reliability in battery management systems.

articleTitle: FR-CBAMNet: A Face Recognition Algorithm by Fusion of Transformer and CNN
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Computer Engineering (ICAICE)
abstract: With the development of deep learning, convolutional neural network is mainstream in face recognition but has two problems: poor recognition accuracy due to neglecting global semantic and key feature information, and difficulty in deployment on resource-constrained devices. This paper proposes lightweight face recognition algorithm FR-CBAMNet, combining Transformer and CNN. It reduces parameters with deeply separable convolution, introduces CBAM for feature selection, and integrates Transformer to capture global semantic information. Experimentally evaluated on nine validation sets, FR-CBAMN et with only 6.1 × 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">5</sup> parameters achieves good balance between parameters and performance.

articleTitle: Adversarial Attack on Image Classification via GANs and Statistical Analysis
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Computer Engineering (ICAICE)
abstract: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) are widely applied in image generation, but their use raises potential security concerns. We propose a novel adversarial attack method based on statistical analysis to identify and analyze the vulnerabilities of image classification systems, ultimately enhancing their defense capabilities. Specifically, we generate statistically significant yet minimally perturbed adversarial samples using GANs, facilitating adversarial learning between the generator and classifier to investigate the statistical characteristics of adversarial samples and their impact on classifier decisions. Through experimental analysis on classic image classification datasets, we demonstrate the effectiveness of our method by comparing it against traditional approaches. Our results show that the adversarial samples generated successfully deceive multiple classifiers while maintaining natural statistical characteristics, revealing inherent distribution properties of adversarial samples.

articleTitle: 3D Spleen Image Registration Method Based on Reinforcement Learning Stochastic Planner-Actor-Critic Model
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Computer Engineering (ICAICE)
abstract: Conventional methods for aligning medical images encounter challenges in effectively capturing the varied morphological attributes of organs such as the spleen and liver. Deep learning algorithms often utilize loss function minimization to deduce image mapping associations, a procedure that may be impeded by local minima. To address these constraints, we introduces a new reinforcement learning strategy termed the stochastic planner-actor-critic (SPAC) model for spleen registration. The SPAC is a reinforcement learning model used for designing registration strategies. The agent observes an image and adjusts its deformation based on reward signals. Through iterative transformations, the agent aligns the organ image with a fixed image. Analyzing the agent's behavior optimizes the registration process. This unsupervised training enables agents to autonomously develop registration strategies, reducing the need for manual intervention and annotation. The findings from the experiment indicate that the Dice similarity coefficient (DSC) achieved by the SPAC model-based method in the task of 3D spleen image registration is 0.829 ± 0.087. In contrast to conventional approaches, the SPAC model demonstrates superior efficacy in addressing the intricate morphology and substantial deformation of the spleen, thereby leading to a notable enhancement in registration precision. This research demonstrates the significant promise of reinforcement learning within the realm of medical image registration, with the SPAC model offering a unique and efficient method for addressing the complexities associated with spleen image registration.

articleTitle: Graph Neural Network with Propagation Operators for Diverse Recommendation
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Computer Engineering (ICAICE)
abstract: In the age of data explosion, recommendation systems are essential for filtering relevant information to alleviate information overload. While precision is critical, an overemphasis on accuracy can lead to filter bubbles and lower user satisfaction. To address this, we introduce PODR-GNN, a model designed to boost recommendation diversity without significantly affecting accuracy. PODR-GNN features two main components: the Propagation Operator Module, which reduces over-smoothing in GNNs, and the Recommendation Reorganization Module, which fine-tunes the recommendation list to enhance user interaction diversity. Extensive experiments on real-world datasets confirm the model's effectiveness in improving both diversity and accuracy.

articleTitle: A Lightweight Model Based on YOLOv8 for Landslide Segmentation in Remote Sensing Images
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Computer Engineering (ICAICE)
abstract: Landslides are one of the most common geological disasters that often result in great loss of human life and property. Using deep learning technology to achieve timely and accurate detection of landslides in remote sensing images is an effective method that can reduce losses. However, designing complex models in the pursuit of higher accuracy will slow down the recognition of the model, which is not satisfactory for fast response when applied to end devices. The limited storage resources and processing power of hardware devices also make it necessary to consider the size of the algorithm. In addition, remote sensing images have complex backgrounds that can easily be confused with landslides, such as terraces, white houses and grounds. In order to solve the above problems, this paper propose an improved model based on the YOLOv8 algorithm. Wherein Conv is replaced by GhostConv and a lightweight cross-scale feature fusion module is introduced, which not only maintains the lightweight features of the model but also improves the model's adaptability to the variation of multi-scale targets. Then, the LSK module is introduced to solve the recognition problem in complex backgrounds, ensuring the accuracy of the improved model. The experimental results show that the parameter size of the proposed lightweight model is 7.58 MB, which is a 40.2% reduction compared to the original model. The mAP is 88.1%, which is a 0.1% improvement over the original model. The improvement of efficiency does not come at the expense of accuracy.

articleTitle: Link Prediction in Directed Graphs via Dummy Node Line Graphs
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Computer Engineering (ICAICE)
abstract: Link prediction plays a critical role in graph mining fields such as social networks, bioinformatics, and recommendation systems. However, existing methods predominantly focus on undirected graphs, with insufficient attention given to directed graphs, which are more common in practical applications. This paper presents a novel Graph Neural Network-based approach for link prediction in directed graphs, incorporating a transformation of line graphs with dummy nodes combined with a Graph Attention Network. This method preserves essential graph structure information through the use of dummy nodes, effectively overcoming the issue of information loss associated with traditional line graph transformations. Furthermore, we propose a fast dummy node line graph transformation algorithm that reduces computational complexity, making it suitable for large-scale graph data applications. Our study provides new insights into directed graph link prediction and holds significant implications for practical applications, including recommendation systems, path optimization, and information dissemination.

articleTitle: The Current Research Status of Unmanned Aerial Vehicle Maneuver Penetration Decision-Making
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Computer Engineering (ICAICE)
abstract: In modern warfare, maneuver penetration is an essential aspect of unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) combat operations. As the capabilities of both offensive and defensive sides continue to improve, the operational patterns of maneuver penetration scenarios are constantly evolving. This paper first introduces the maneuver capabilities and detection characteristics of both offensive and defensive systems in contemporary warfare, providing a macro definition of the maneuver penetration problem. Then, it conducts a survey and analysis of the applications of traditional and new artificial intelligence algorithms in maneuver penetration decision-making. Finally, it discusses the future research directions and challenges of artificial intelligence algorithms in this field and envisions the development of maneuver penetration decision-making.

articleTitle: Research on the Application of Deep Learning-Based Product Spray Code Text Recognition Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Computer Engineering (ICAICE)
abstract: In the process of product manufacturing, the characters printed on the packaging may be incomplete due to reasons such as rapid mechanical vibrations, low ink quality, and poor operating environments. Therefore, manufacturers often perform defect detection of printed codes during the product quality inspection phase. To achieve efficient recognition of printed codes in complex environments, this paper adopts a sequence-based CRNN text recognition algorithm and designs a lightweight network structure. First, MobileNetV3_small is used as the feature extraction network, optimizing the sampling stride to better preserve the character features in the image. Then, a bidirectional Long Short-Term Memory network (Bi-LSTM) is used to predict the text sequence, combined with the CTC loss function to achieve end-to-end variable-length text sequence recognition. To verify the performance of the improved algorithm, experiments were conducted on two commonly used text recognition datasets,IIIT5K-Words and ICDAR2013. The experimental results show that the combination of CRNN and MobileNetV3_small not only effectively improves the speed of text recognition but also ensures the accuracy of printed code recognition, thereby enhancing the effectiveness of quality inspection for printed codes.

articleTitle: An Energy-Efficient Routing Protocol Based on Ordering Points and Shared Neighbor Degree in WSNs
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Computer Engineering (ICAICE)
abstract: Wireless sensor networks (WSNs) are made up of several geographically dispersed sensor nodes that are connected by wireless media in order to track and capture physical data from the surroundings.
