In some complex environments, it is difficult to recover the energy of sensor nodes, so the existing energy needs to be used more efficiently. For WSN, clustering is one of the important ways to balance energy consumption among nodes and improve network performance. Therefore, this paper proposes an Energy-Efficient Routing Protocol Based on Ordering Points and Shared Neighbor Degree in WSNs (SPBERP). In the network Clustering stage, the protocol uses the Ordering Points to Identify the Clustering algorithm. In cluster head selection, the local density is redefined by shared proximity, and the cluster head selection scheme is optimized by considering the residual energy, relative position and local density of nodes. The data is transmitted to the base station in the form of multiple hops. The outcomes of the experiment demonstrate that the protocol can successfully lower network energy consumption.

articleTitle: Color Analysis and Application of Mongolian Traditional Costumes Based on K-means Clustering Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Computer Engineering (ICAICE)
abstract: Objective: Aiming at the current deficiencies in color selection in Mongolian-related designs, this study aims to analyze the color characteristics of Mongolian costumes in a visual way, so as to provide color matching references for related design fields. Methods: 72 sets of Mongolian traditional costumes were selected and preprocessed, and the K-means clustering algorithm was applied to cluster the colors of the costumes in order to extract the dominant colors, and a color model was constructed to summarize the color characteristics in terms of three dimensions: lightness, hue, and saturation. CONCLUSION: The K-means clustering algorithm combined with the color model was used to reveal the color characteristics of Mongolian traditional costumes. It can provide a reference for the color matching of related designs and plays an important role in the inheritance of ethnic culture.

articleTitle: “Prediction Study on the Removal Efficiency of Arsenic Ions in Water Using Modified Biochar Based on Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Computer Engineering (ICAICE)
abstract: This study utilized modified biochar as an adsorbent, combined with machine learning and multi-objective optimization methods, to investigate the impact of process parameters on the removal efficiency of arsenic ions (As(V)) from water, with the aim of optimizing the adsorption process conditions [1]. Through the visualization of experimental data, the effects of temperature and pH on adsorption efficiency were examined [2]. A quantitative model was developed, integrating traditional regression analysis with three machine learning algorithms, and hyperparameters were optimized [3]. The results showed that when the pH value exceeded 7, the adsorption rate dropped significantly [4]. The BPNN model exhibited the best fitting accuracy, with an R2 value of 0.993, outperforming traditional statistical models [5]. This study provides a scientific basis for optimizing the adsorption process parameters [6].

articleTitle: Research on Optimized Design of Generative Artificial Intelligence APP Based on Kano Model
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Computer Engineering (ICAICE)
abstract: With the continuous progress of computer science, the information content of the Internet has evolved from PGC and UGC to the present situation of dominated by artificial intelligence content generation, and the generative artificial intelligence APPs led by chatgpt keep emerging. This paper takes the results of the demand research of generative AI APP as the research sample, aims to improve user experience, classifies the functional requirements in this field based on the KANO model and correlation coefficient analysis, and ultimately carries out the design practice of generative AI APP based on the results of the research and produces the design results. The purpose is to provide reference opinions for the innovation and optimization of the functional design of generative AI APP for the development trend of AI.

articleTitle: Research on Generative Adversarial Networks of Pore Structure Prediction in Geological Samples
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Computer Engineering (ICAICE)
abstract: The prediction of the pore structure of rock formations is of critical importance for the comprehension of fluid flow and storage capacity in underground reservoirs. The conventional techniques frequently encounter difficulties in addressing the intricacy and variability of pore distribution. In this work, we put forward a novel GAN framework that has been designed with the specific purpose of predicting pore structures. The framework comprises a generator that generates images of pore structures incorporating authentic geological characteristics through a deep convolutional neural network (DCNN), while simultaneously performing feature extraction on the input geological data. The discriminator employs the adversarial training strategy, which enables the differentiation and assessment of generated samples and real samples through the convolutional layer. The minimised adversarial loss function is utilised to enhance the authenticity of the generated samples. The model was trained on multiple geological sample datasets, combining different pore characteristics and spatial distribution information, in order to ensure its generalisability and accuracy. The results of the experimental analysis demonstrate that our GAN-based method is markedly more effective than the traditional prediction model, exhibiting enhanced accuracy and reliability in capturing the spatial distribution of pore structures.

articleTitle: Optimization of XGBoost Algorithm for Road Traffic Flow Regression Prediction Based on Four-Vector Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Computer Engineering (ICAICE)
abstract: This paper aims to optimize the traditional XGBoost regression model by using the four-vector algorithm, so as to achieve the accurate prediction of road traffic flow. The main objective of the experiment is to predict the traffic flow based on multiple parameters of vehicles on the road, and compare the difference between the predicted results and the actual flow, so as to verify the prediction effect of the proposed model. The experimental results show that in terms of fitness curve, when the number of iterations reaches 8, the fitness decreases from 0.045 to 0.039 for the first time, and when the number of iterations reaches 18, the fitness further decreases to 0.038 and remains stable. This shows that the model gradually converges during the training process and the performance is improved. Through the analysis of the prediction line chart of the training set, it can be seen that the predicted value of the traffic flow of the model is highly consistent with the actual value, and the root mean square error (RMSE) is 3.0077. At the same time, when verified on the test set, the model also shows good prediction ability, RMSE is 3.5249, which indicates that the model has strong generalization ability. To fully evaluate the model performance, we compared the coefficient of determination (R<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>), mean absolute error (MAE), mean deviation error (MBE), and root mean square error (RMSE), respectively. The results show that the difference between the two parameters is small, which further proves the validity and reliability of the model on unknown data. In summary, by optimizing the XGBoost regression model, this study provides a new idea and method for road traffic flow prediction, which not only improves the prediction accuracy, but also lays a foundation for the future development of intelligent transportation system. Effective traffic flow prediction not only helps to alleviate urban traffic congestion, but also helps to improve road safety and resource utilization efficiency. Therefore, this study has important practical significance.

articleTitle: Image Recognition Technology Improves the Efficiency of Historical Drawing Management in Archives
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Computer Engineering (ICAICE)
abstract: The archive faces a substantial workload in manually recognizing and renaming a large number of scanned historical drawings. This paper proposes an automated solution based on image recognition technology to improve the efficiency of drawing management. The system utilizes OCR (Optical Character Recognition) and computer vision technologies to automatically identify drawing information and rename the files, thereby reducing manual operations and enhancing work efficiency.

articleTitle: Based on Optimization LSTM Model of the Valve Cooling Equipment Fault Diagnosis Method of Parallel Research
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Computer Engineering (ICAICE)
abstract: Valve cooling equipment of converter station is an important part of high voltage transmission system. When the main pump or other components fail, there will be problems in the operation of the valve cooling system, which will affect the normal operation of the converter station and even the regional power grid. To solve this problem, this paper proposes a fault diagnosis method of valve cooling equipment with improved long short-term memory network (LSTM). Firstly, the vibration data of the main pump of the valve cooling system is collected and processed. One dimensional convolutional neural network (1DCNN) was used to optimize and upgrade the LSTM model, and two convolution kernels of different sizes were selected to extract the fluctuation features of vibration signals at different frequencies. Form a fusion feature. Then, the data are normalized in batches and time characteristics are extracted by LSTM. Finally, the parallel acceleration module is used to improve the speed of the algorithm diagnosis. The experimental results show that the accuracy of the network obtained from the test set is 97.7%, and the proposed method is better than other methods in the main pump fault diagnosis of valve cooling system.

articleTitle: Research on PCB Defect Detection Algorithm Based on Improved YOLOv8
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Computer Engineering (ICAICE)
abstract: To address the challenges posed by small targets and low accuracy in printed circuit board defect detection, this study proposes an enhanced PCB defect detection algorithm based on YOLOv8, termed yolo-bifpn. This algorithm incorporates BiFPN as its feature fusion architecture, utilizing bi-directional multi-scale feature fusion to enable the model to more effectively differentiate between defects with similar attributes and those exhibiting significant scale differences. Consequently, this approach significantly enhances the target recall rate. Furthermore, we introduce a novel loss function named Inner-MPDloU, which integrates a scale factor ratio into MPDIoU for controlling the size of the auxiliary bounding box. This new loss function can dynamically adjust the weighting of various components during different stages of model training, thereby further improving image detection performance. Experimental results indicate that compared to YOLOv8n, our improved model achieves an mAP50 of 94% on the PCB dataset-a 0.7% increase-and reaches an mAP50-95 of 47.8%, marking a substantial enhancement of 2.7% in recall rates.

articleTitle: A Two-Stage Emotional Dialogue Generation Model Based on DialoGPT
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Computer Engineering (ICAICE)
abstract: The creation of emotionally rich dialogues has become an increasingly important area in natural language processing (NLP), aiming to improve human-computer interactions. Existing models frequently rely on a single emotional variable, which may produce repetitive and less varied responses. To overcome these challenges, we introduce a two-stage dialogue generation model featuring a novel emotional variable fusion strategy. In the initial stage, a fine-tuned DialoGPT model is employed to produce semantically coherent responses. In the subsequent stage, we enhance emotional diversity through emotional rewriting by integrating primary and auxiliary emotional variables, while preserving semantic accuracy. Experiments conducted on the EmpatheticDialogues dataset show that our model surpasses baseline models regarding fluency, relevance, and emotional engagement.

articleTitle: Enhancing Large-Scale Pre-Trained Models with Mixer for Far-Field ASR
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Computer Engineering (ICAICE)
abstract: Although the significant improvements of Automatic Speech Recognition systems is achieved by the end-to-end modeling technology, especially the use of large-scale pretrained models. Far-Field Speech Recognition still faces the challenges due to signal degradation, such as low signal-to-noise ratio, reverberation, and background noise. To overcome these issues, we introduce an innovative data augmentation technique called Mixer to enhance the performance of large-scale pretrained models in FSR, by interpolated and mixed the features to represent the speech samples and the corresponding losses. Experimental results show that compared to the Whisper acrossed all version, including SpecAugment, the proposed method has reduced 3.6% Word Error Rate.

articleTitle: Research on Automatic Detection of Cracks in Wind Turbine Blades Based on Multi-Scale Feature Fusion
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Computer Engineering (ICAICE)
abstract: Addressing the issues of low detection efficiency and increasing missed detection rates caused by the significant variations in wind turbine blade cracks, we propose a crack defect detection model that integrates multi-scale features. This model aims to automatically extract and evaluate cracks on wind turbine blades, even in complex backgrounds. Furthermore, we use data augmentation techniques to optimize the dataset, addressing the shortage of image samples and thereby increasing the data sample size. Moreover, we address the problem of overfitting during model training by using incremental data, which effectively improves the accuracy of the network model. By fusing high-level features within the network and capturing contextual information features at multiple scales, we achieve pixel-level extraction of cracks on wind turbine blades in complex backgrounds.

articleTitle: Research on Traffic Flow Analysis Based on LSTM Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Computer Engineering (ICAICE)
abstract: Traffic flow prediction has become a hot issue, and many algorithms have been applied in traffic flow predictionBy constructing and training the model, the future traffic flow can be better predicted. Through theoretical elaboration and experimental results, it is proved that it does have higher execution effect and reliability, and greatly improves the accuracy of real-time traffic flow prediction. According to the prediction results, the traffic management department can focus on the areas that may be congested in the future, implement traffic control in a timely manner, and reduce the incidence of road congestion and traffic accidents, which has important stability of traffic flow prediction, alleviating the traffic congestion problem of the city, and realizing green transportation and sustainable urban development.

articleTitle: An Improved YOLOv5-Based Method for Small Object Detection in Aerial Images
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Computer Engineering (ICAICE)
abstract: Due to the good development prospects in the field of UAV aerial photography, object detection methods based on deep learning have developed rapidly in recent years, but also have many challenges. In this paper, the YOLO series model is studied and analyzed, and the YOLOv5 network is used as the benchmark model to improve it. The main contributions as follows: The graph neural network (GNN) is combined with the traditional CLoU Loss algorithm to partition specific detection boundary boxes. The feature extraction stage of the model adopts GNN and the boundary regression stage adopts CLoU Loss, aims to improve the overall accuracy and flexibility of the improved YOLOv5 network. And after detecting three important indicators of FPS, recall rate and model size of different models, the following results can be obtained: The improved YOLOv5 model (IY5) has a model size of 31.3MB, a mAP of 96.5%, and a FPS of 57.6. From a comprehensive view of the three indexes, the accuracy of the “IY5” algorithm is the highest among all models, and the balance between model size and real-time performance is also achieved, which indicates that our algorithm design takes both accuracy improvement and practicality into consideration.

articleTitle: The Ship Edge Detection based on High and Low Thresholds Method
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Computer Engineering (ICAICE)
abstract: In order to lessen the decline in the accuracy of ship edge detection caused by the noise produced during the acquisition of remote-sensing images, This paper introduces ship detection technique utilizing significance of Thresholds. By examining the connection about the anatomy of the Visual System features, the target is identified through edge detection. Initially, the image undergoes enhancement via second-order differentiation. Subsequently, the edge operator is refined, incorporating significance thresholds for the enhancement of the contrast between points on the edge and those not on the edge. Considering edges is the foreground and non-edges is the background, leading to the identification of target. The method can significantly cut down on false edges during detection and reach a high level of detection accuracy.

articleTitle: Data Visualization Analysis of Research Hotspots and Trends in Low Carbon Campus Studies
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Computer Engineering (ICAICE)
abstract: Based on the background of the ‘dual-carbon’ goal, the construction of low-carbon campuses is still in its infancy. In order to understand the development of low-carbon campus research and study the research hotspots and future development trends of low-carbon campus in domestic and foreign academia, this paper uses CiteSpace software to visualise and analyse the literature in CNKI and WoS databases from 2014–2024, and draws the conclusions that (1) domestic and foreign scholars have continued to pay attention to the issue, and there has been a significant surge in research progress in this field in 2008. (2) Domestic and foreign research collaboration networks have not yet been completed, and teamwork is weak. (3) There is a focus bias in domestic and foreign research hotspots, with domestic research focusing on low-carbon culture, concepts and conceptual interpretations, and foreign research focusing on quantitative research on energy conservation and emission reduction. In the future, the research in this field should further promote the sharing of resources, innovate the mode of cooperation, deepen the integration of disciplines, and establish visualisation standards, so as to provide certain theoretical references and practical help for the construction of low-carbon campuses.

articleTitle: Research on Anime Recommendation Algorithm Based on Parallel Feature Interaction
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Computer Engineering (ICAICE)
abstract: In recent years, the animation industry has experienced rapid growth, leading to an explosive increase in available animation resources. How to accurately recommend personalized animation content for users has emerged as a significant challenge in the industry. Due to the diversity of user preferences and animation content characteristics, the application of recommender systems in the field of animation faces great challenges. In order to solve the problem that it is difficult for users to find content that meets their interests in massive resources, the research of personalized recommendation algorithm is of great significance. Building on an analysis of current recommendation models, this paper presents a personalized anime recommendation algorithm based on parallel feature interaction. The algorithm combines multi-dimensional features such as user viewing history, interest preference, style and theme of animation content, and deeply excavates the relationship between users and animation resources through parallel feature interaction modeling, and finally realizes personalized recommendation. Experimental results demonstrate that the proposed algorithm performs exceptionally well in recommendation accuracy and has important application value for content distribution and user experience improvement in the animation industry.

articleTitle: Acoustic Detection of Lining Void: Realization with Light-Weight Algorithms and Edge Devices
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Computer Engineering (ICAICE)
abstract: This paper proposes a strategy for deploying lightweight and miniaturized deep-learning algorithms on edge devices, aiming to solve the problems of poor accuracy in manual operations and high cost of traditional detection devices in tunnel lining void detection without relying on cloud-service conditions. By analyzing different voiceprint characteristics of knocking sounds, the Mel-Frequency Cepstral Coefficients (MFCC) are used to extract key features of sound signals, and Principal Component Analysis (PCA) and Global Average Pooling (GAP) techniques are adopted for dimension-reduction processing to reduce data volume and computational resource requirements. On the GPU platform, multi-dimensional high-speed parallel training of the Artificial Neural Network (ANN) is achieved. Using the RK3568 platform, edge-device deployment testing without relying on Internet-of-Things communication is finally realized. Experimental results show that when the MFCC dimension reaches 16 and above 20, the accuracy of the test set exceeds 96%, verifying the effectiveness and high-efficiency of this scheme.

articleTitle: A Hybrid Model of Multiple CNNs with Attention Mechanism for Optimized Facial Expression Recognition
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Computer Engineering (ICAICE)
abstract: Facial expression recognition is integral to enhancing human-machine interactions, applicable across security, advertising, and social media. Traditionally, these systems relied on handcrafted features or basic algorithms, but advancements in computational power and neural network architecture like Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) have shifted this trend. This study presents a hybrid model combining multiple CNNs-MobileNetV1, MobileNetV2, and ResNet50-with an attention mechanism to improve the robustness and accuracy of facial expression recognition. Utilizing the strengths of these networks, the model utilizes an ensemble approach where feature extractions are integrated and optimized using a random forest to determine the most effective weightings for final predictions. This method not only harnesses the power of deep learning to enhance feature detection across diverse conditions but also implements transfer learning (i.e. ImageNet weights) to address challenges posed by small or non-varied datasets, significantly advancing the abilities of facial expression recognition systems.

articleTitle: Neural Network-Based Analysis of Local Extreme Cold Events in the Context of Global Warming: Causes and Predictions
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Computer Engineering (ICAICE)
abstract: Global warming is a pressing issue, accompanied by both rising temperatures and local extreme cold events. This paper analyzes the relationship between global warming and extreme weather events through quantitative analysis of climate data. Focusing on the United States as a representative of regions experiencing extreme cold, a neural network model is developed to predict these events. Results indicate that rising global temperatures positively correlate with increased snowfall in the US, while negatively impacting US winter temperatures. This suggests that as global average temperatures increase, US winters become colder with more snow. The study concludes that global warming and local extreme cold events are not contradictory but strongly correlated phenomena.

articleTitle: Semantic Segmentation of Road Landscape Based on Improved Deeplabv3+
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Computer Engineering (ICAICE)
abstract: Image semantic segmentation is a critical task in the field of computer vision. However, traditional Deeplabv3+ faces challenges such as a large number of parameters and insufficient accuracy when handling small objects and object edges. Therefore, we propose an improved lightweight road semantic segmentation algorithm, WDeeplabv3+, based on the Deeplabv3+ network. (1) We introduce a Three-Parallel Down-sampling Feature Extraction Module (TPDFE), which enriches low-level features and enhances the model's ability to capture details. (2) We replace Bilinear interpolation up-sampling with CARAFE up-sampling and propose a Grouped Spatial Feature Fusion Module (GSFFM). After feature interaction, we use attention guidance for feature fusion, effectively alleviating the semantic gap in feature integration while achieving network lightweighting. (3) Shuffle attention is added to improve the model's feature expression ability and its capacity to capture long-range dependencies. At the same time, it retains important information while reducing computational complexity. Experimental results show that on the CamVid dataset, mIoU and mPA increased by 3.16% and 2.10%, respectively, while the number of parameters and computation load decreased by 88% and 96%.

articleTitle: Maneuvering Decision Modeling Method Based on Attitude Controller
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Computer Engineering (ICAICE)
abstract: Reinforcement learning is developing rapidly in the field of CGF maneuver modeling, however, restricted by the uninterpretability of neural network and insufficient exploration of state space, the modeling of maneuver decision-making confronts poor stability under the boundary conditions, so it still needs the rule-based model as an effective supplement. A maneuver decision modeling method based on attitude controller is proposed, which can effectively avoid the singularity problem by using a quaternion attitude controller, and realize the shortest path transformation of any attitude by combining with the geometric spherical linear interpolation method. Integrated with a simple maneuver rule based on position advantage and threat assessment, the maneuver decision modeling is carried out. The platform is based on the JSBSim dynamics model, and the simulation results show that the controller is stable in 1 vs. 1 machine-machine and human-computer gaming with certain intelligence.

articleTitle: Virtual Screening of Natural Anti-Senescent Compounds Based on Sq-TabPFN
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Computer Engineering (ICAICE)
abstract: To address the issue of feature redundancy and mutual interference in the screening of anti-aging compounds, a novel screening method based on Sq-TabPFN is proposed. Sq-TabPFN adaptively selects the most important features through a sequential attention mechanism, employs a sparse activation function to enhance feature sparsity, and utilizes a prior scale term to improve the flexibility of feature selection. This approach effectively removes redundant features, resulting in more accurate predictions of the anti-aging properties of natural compounds. Experimental results demonstrate that the proposed method outperforms baseline models in accuracy and successfully identifies 9 compounds with potential anti-aging activity. This study provides an efficient tool for the virtual screening of natural anti-aging compounds, which can accelerate drug discovery and reduce the cost of drug development.

articleTitle: Multi-Scale HyperGraph Node Embedding via Random Walking for Music Recommendation
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Computer Engineering (ICAICE)
abstract: Recommender systems are designed to deliver tailored recommendations to users, demonstrating efficacy in addressing the issue of data overload prevalent in numerous online platforms. Current music recommendation systems have produced considerable results, but due to the complexity and diversity of the interaction between users and music and the background of listening time, as well as the dynamics of user preferences, making full use of music listening records remains a challenging and important problem. Therefore, a novel Multi-Scale HyperGraph Node (MSHN) Embedding approach for sequential music recommendation is proposed in this paper. Firstly, a devised Weighted Random Walk Algorithm is used to learn the First-order Markov node sequence. Secondly, Users' preferences are subsequently inferred from their listening habits, leading to recommendations of music pieces that align with their immediate needs. Finally, extensive experiments are performed on two real-world datasets, demonstrating that MSHN outperforms baseline models.

articleTitle: SFNet: Dynamic Memory Action Recognition Based on Point Weighted Attention Enhancement
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Computer Engineering (ICAICE)
abstract: Millimeter-wave (mmWave) radar sensors are now viable for non-contact human activity recognition in contexts such as personnel tracking and smart homes. Traditional point cloud data methods face high computational loads and empty voxel challenges. Addressing these, this paper introduces fixed bounding boxes and vertex weighting to optimize information capture. We further apply a two-dimensional dual-view fusion with voxelized data, enhancing spatial and temporal motion analysis. This approach not only increases adaptability and stability in diverse settings but also strengthens robustness. Our point-weighted attention-augmented dynamic memory model (SFNet) utilizes a fully convolutional network for spatial feature extraction and a time series module for temporal insights. An integrated attention mechanism targets key features, improving robustness and generalizability. Tests on MMActivity and MMGesture datasets show enhanced accuracy and consistency, affirming the method's efficacy in complex environments.

articleTitle: Optimization Research on Deep Learning-Based Image Classification Algorithms in Computer Vision
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Computer Engineering (ICAICE)
abstract: Aiming at the problems of high computational complexity and insufficient accuracy of traditional deep learning image classification algorithms, a novel network structure called DARN (Dual Attention ResNet) is designed. This method embeds channel attention and spatial attention modules in the residual blocks, optimizes the training strategy, and reduces the algorithm complexity. On the ImageNet dataset, the classification accuracy reaches 78.6%, which is 2.3% higher than the original ResNet50, with a 20.5% reduction in parameters and a 31% increase in inference speed, achieving a balance between model performance and computational efficiency.

articleTitle: Lightweight Small Target Detection Algorithm for UAV Infrared Aerial Photography Based on YOLOv8
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Computer Engineering (ICAICE)
abstract: Aiming at the complexity of UAV infrared air target detection model,a lightweight target detection algorithm based on YOLOv8 n is proposed. By introducing a lightweight Depthwise Convolution module, the model size is reduced to facilitate deployment on mobile devices. The experimental results on the HIT-UAV dataset show that compared with the benchmark model YOLOv8n, the improved algorithm reduces the number of parameters and GFLOPs by 0.6M and 1.2G, respectively. In summary, the effectiveness of the algorithm is verified, which provides the possibility for the UAV to perform real-time target detection tasks.

articleTitle: An Optimization Method for Traffic Signals Oriented Towards Multi-Priority Vehicles
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Computer Engineering (ICAICE)
abstract: The traditional traffic signal control system usually relies on fixed or dynamic preset time period regulation schemes, which has a limited response to the real-time changes in traffic flow and the demand of different vehicle priorities. Existing control strategies are difficult to ensure the fast passage of high-priority vehicles while providing sufficient passage guarantees for normal vehicles. In this paper, we propose a deep reinforcement learning traffic signal control method for multi-priority vehicles. Firstly, we improve the DQN by using the dueling structure. Secondly, we assign different weights to different priority vehicles and redesign the agent's state information and reward function. In simulation experiments, we compare four similar traffic signal control methods, and the experimental results prove the effectiveness of our proposed method.

articleTitle: Survey of Semantic-Based Image-to-Image Retrieval
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Computer Engineering (ICAICE)
abstract: Image-to-image retrieval has been a focal point of research in both academia and industry over the past few decades, finding applications across various fields. However, with advancements in technology, early methods have revealed limitations in efficiency and the ability to accurately interpret semantic information within images. Consequently, achieving semantic image-to-image retrieval has become a critical challenge in this domain. This paper reviews recent developments in semantic image retrieval technologies by summarizing and discussing the implementations and pros and cons of various approaches. We begin by introducing commonly used datasets and evaluation metrics pertinent to this task. Next, we present representative algorithms for both single-object image retrieval and complex scene image retrieval, categorized by their application scenarios. Finally, we summarize the pressing issues that remain in current image retrieval technologies and analyze potential future research directions.

articleTitle: Study on Chinese Lip Reading Recognition Algorithm Based on Mixed Decoding Strategy with Conformer Architecture
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Computer Engineering (ICAICE)
abstract: Existing methods often model the temporal sequence of video frames using Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) networks. However, this approach suffers from significant information loss. In particular, when video information is incomplete, the model may confuse lip movements at different time points, leading to a substantial drop in recognition performance. This paper proposes a model based on the Conformer encoder and a hybrid decoding mechanism. The model integrates a Conv3D+ResNet-18 visual frontend and employs a Vision Attend and Spell (VAS) decoder to achieve sentence-level lip-reading recognition in Chinese, termed Conv3D+ResNet-18-Conformer-VAs (3DConf-VAS). Specifically, the model first extracts spatial features from raw pixels using Conv3D+ResNet-18 and then inputs these features into the Conformer encoder for temporal modeling. Subsequently, the model combines Connectionist Temporal Classification (CTC) with attention mechanisms for training and decoding, fully leveraging both spatial and temporal information to enhance overall performance. Evaluation on the CMLR dataset reveals that the proposed 3DConf-VAS model achieves a substantial improvement in recognition accuracy for sentence-level lip-reading tasks, highlighting the effectiveness of the approach.

articleTitle: Parallel Deep Reinforcement Learning Based Fault Diagnosis Study of Flexible Straight Valve Cold Main Circulating Pumps
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Computer Engineering (ICAICE)
abstract: In a flexible direct-valve cooling system, the normal operation of the main circulation pump is a key link in the cooling system, and its failure will directly affect the stability and reliability of the system. In this paper, an integrated model for main circulation pump fault diagnosis based on parallel deep reinforcement learning is proposed to ensure the stable operation of the system. First, three models, namely, multilayer perceptron, convolutional neural network and long and short-term memory network, are utilized as the basic learners for fault diagnosis. Then, the outputs of each base learner are integrated by a weighting model based on deep reinforcement learning, and different weights are assigned to each base learner. Finally, a coach-member approach is proposed to obtain an integrated diagnostic model through parallel training. The experimental results show that the model achieves an accuracy and precision of 95.00%, with a recall and F1 score of 86.36% and 90.48%, respectively, which provides an effective means of fault diagnosis for the system and helps to improve the operational reliability of the flexible straight valve cooling system.

articleTitle: Application of AutomationML/OPC UA in Robot Interoperability
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Computer Engineering (ICAICE)
abstract: This paper focuses on the application of AutomationML (AML) and Open Platform Communications Unified Architecture (OPC UA) in robot interoperability, aiming to promote the intelligence and interoperability of production systems in the era of Industry 4.0. By analyzing the current challenges of industrial robot interoperability, especially in terms of data standardization, a robot system architecture is proposed to improve the compatibility and information exchange efficiency between different types of robots. Research methods include system architecture design, integration of AML and OPCUA methods, and their empirical application in real-world manufacturing environments. The results confirm the feasibility and practicability of the method in the application of industrial robots, and give different devices higher interoperability and flexible response ability. It provides a theoretical basis and practical guidance for the development of intelligent manufacturing systems in the future, and has important practical significance and application value in improving the level of industrial digitalization and intelligence.

articleTitle: High Precision Indoor Positioning Management System for Hospital Person&Equipment Based on UWB/BLE Fusion
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Computer Engineering (ICAICE)
abstract: To achieve high precision indoor positioning of persons and equipment in hospital environment, this project was completed. Firstly, the indoor positioning algorithm of UWB/BLE fusion was studied, and the Extended Kalman Filter Particle Filter(EKF-PF) fusion positioning optimization algorithm was proposed, which fundamentally improves the positioning accuracy of the system. Second, NB-IoT module was used to combine UWB and BLE circuits to design a positioning beacon, which is combined with the appropriately deployed indoor positioning base station to complete the design of the fusion indoor positioning hardware system. Third, JAVA language was used to complete the design of the background management system, and Android Studio was used to complete the design of mobile phone positioning APP. Finally, the software and hardware mentioned above were integrated, and a complete hospital high-precision indoor positioning management system was developed. The experimental results show that the EKF-PF can effectively improve the positioning accuracy and reduce the positioning cumulative error. Hospital high-precision indoor positioning system can effectively realize the high-precision positioning of persons and equipment, and meet the daily operation needs of the hospital.

articleTitle: Web-Based Virtual Simulation Instrument Configuration Development System
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Computer Engineering (ICAICE)
abstract: When using traditional software to develop the virtual flight indication instrument simulation interface for aircraft simulators, users face problems such as the inability to quickly build the interface, the inability to cross-platform development and the complexity of program writing. To address these problems, we use the development tool VAPS XT to develop common virtual instrument components, use the Qt framework to load the instrument components and realize data reception, realize the instrument library and simulation interface running programs, migrate the user interface to the web side, and integrate it into a convenient development system, so that the user only needs to select the encapsulated instrument components and make slight modifications to them when designing, so that the user can complete the simulation interface design directly online, without relying on the programming language and local software. The user only needs to select the encapsulated instrument components and modify them slightly during the design, and can complete the simulation interface design directly online without relying on programming language and local software. After testing, the simulation interface development can be completed quickly through this system, which significantly improves the convenience of use and development efficiency.

articleTitle: Tail Risk Alert Based on Conditional Autoregressive VaR by Regression Quantiles and Machine Learning Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Computer Engineering (ICAICE)
abstract: As the increasing application of AI in finance, this paper will leverage AI algorithms to examine tail risk and develop a model to alter tail risk to promote the stability of US financial markets, and enhance the resilience of the US economy. Specifically, the paper constructs a multivariate multilevel CAViaR model, optimized by gradient descent and genetic algorithm, to study the tail risk spillover between the US stock market, foreign exchange market and credit market. The model is used to provide early warning of related risks in US stocks, US credit bonds, etc. The results show that, by analyzing the direction, magnitude, and pseudo-impulse response of the risk spillover, it is found that the credit market's spillover effect on the stock market and its duration are both greater than the spillover effect of the stock market and the other two markets on credit market, placing credit market in a central position for warning of extreme risks. Its historical information on extreme risks can serve as a predictor of the VaR of other markets.

articleTitle: Named Entity Recognition of Chinese Intangible Cultural Names Based on Part-of-Speech Tagging
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Computer Engineering (ICAICE)
abstract: By observing many intangible cultural heritage names, it is found that although the frequency of occurrence of these names is relatively low, they are often composed of multiple high-frequency words. Further analysis of the parts-of-speech distribution of these high-frequency words shows that there is a certain regularity. Consequently, a named entity recognition model based on POS tagging was presented in this study. By including the POS into the word vector, the word vector's information was increased and the name recognition accuracy for intangible cultural assets was enhanced. Compared with BERTBiLSTM-CRF, the F1 score of the proposed model in the name recognition task of intangible cultural heritage items is increased from 0.854 to 0.933, an increase of 0.079.

articleTitle: Fingerprint Recognition Based on Convolutional Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Computer Engineering (ICAICE)
abstract: Fingerprint recognition is a cornerstone in the field of image recognition, computer vision and artificial intelligence, commonly used to identify people based on unique patterns on their fingers. This research uses Deep Learning, a type of artificial intelligence that can learn from data to build a fingerprint recognition system. Using fingerprint images from a public dataset provided by NeuroTechnology and the FVC2002 collection, we employed a Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) as the primary model to train our system to recognize fingerprint patterns. This study explores how deep learning can improve fingerprint recognition for better security, making it more reliable and practical for everyday use.

articleTitle: Efficient Learning and Face Detection Tracking Based on Artificial Intelligence Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Computer Engineering (ICAICE)
abstract: In the field of facial recognition and tracking, facing challenges such as complex backgrounds, lighting changes, and partial facial occlusion, how to improve detection efficiency and tracking accuracy has become an urgent problem to be solved. In response to this issue, this article proposes a comprehensive method for efficient learning and face detection tracking based on artificial intelligence algorithms. Firstly, the Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) in deep learning is used to extract facial features in order to improve the accuracy of face detection; subsequently, real-time face detection is implemented using the improved You Only Look Once (YOLO) algorithm, which improves the robustness and efficiency of detection in complex backgrounds; finally, based on Kalman filter and optical flow method, the detected faces are tracked to ensure the stability and continuity of the tracking process. In the experiment, this method also has high detection accuracy in complex backgrounds, with detection speeds reaching 15–60 FPS on different hardware platforms, significantly higher than SSD (Single Shot MultiBox Detector) and Faster R-CNN algorithms; in addition, in tracking tests under occlusion and fast motion conditions, the average displacement error (ADE) is 3.5 pixels for slight occlusion, 7.2 pixels for moderate occlusion, and 15.4 pixels for severe occlusion, respectively. Compared with traditional methods, the proposed method has higher tracking accuracy and stability, fully verifying its superiority and practicality in complex scenes.

articleTitle: Multi-Level Relation Embedding with Attention Mechanism for Few-Shot Remote Sensing Image Scene Classification
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Computer Engineering (ICAICE)
abstract: Given the limited availability of annotated remote sensing image samples, which renders traditional deep learning algorithms ineffective, and considering the complex spatial semantic features with high intra-class variability and inter-class similarity, we propose the RNC_SCAM model based on multi-level relation embedding with an attention mechanism. This model is designed for few-shot remote sensing image scene classification in defense and military applications, offering significant benefits for military reconnaissance, target identification, and localization. A hybrid attention mechanism is integrated into the feature extraction network to enhance the network's ability to extract and represent fundamental image features more effectively. The basic feature maps are input into the Self-Association Module (SAM) and Cross-Association Module (CAM) in sequence to achieve multi-level relationship embedding to fully learn the feature relationships within and between image classes. The experimental results show that when the experimental settings are 5way-1shot and 5way-5shot, the average classification accuracy of the RNC_SCAM model on the NWPU-RESISC45 and AID datasets are 74.57±0.39%, 90.01±0.19% and 66.70±0.43%, 80.73±0.26% respectively, the classification effect has been significantly improved.

articleTitle: WheatNGP: Neural Radiation Field Optimization for Wheat Flocks Under Boundless Free Trajectories
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Computer Engineering (ICAICE)
abstract: Accurate NeRF synthesis can help plant breeders to effectively analyze and identify plant traits to improve crop yield. Most of the existing mesh-based NeRF new perspective synthesis methods are targeted at bounded scenes, such as Instant-NGP, Plenoxels, DVGO, and tensorf, but wheat is usually grown in outdoor field environments, which belongs to non-boundary scenes. At present, the widely used method is to rely on space warping, but it can only deal with forward trajectory and 360° center surround trajectory, which is a special trajectory, and can't deal with arbitrary trajectory, but there are more free trajectories in the daily shooting process. In order to solve this problem, we propose a new warping function called Variable warping. In this study, we use cell phone to shoot wheat experimental field data, and use the improved Variable warping algorithm to synthesize the new perspective of wheat under free trajectory. The experimental results show that it allows us to reconstruct the new perspective of wheat with high quality under arbitrary camera trajectory. The experimental results show that allows us to perform high-quality reconstruction of wheat under arbitrary camera trajectories with new perspective synthesis.

articleTitle: PGPNet:A Novel Iterative Partial-Global-Partial Point Cloud Registration Method
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Computer Engineering (ICAICE)
abstract: Point cloud registration is crucial for aligning partial scans in computer vision and robotics, but low-overlap scenarios hinder its effectiveness. This study introduces PGPNet, a neural network designed for low and zero-overlap point cloud registration by reformulating the problem into a partial-global-partial framework. PGPNet uses a global point cloud as an intermediary, enhancing overlap between partial clouds. It employs a dual-branch module with squared scores and a similarity matrix for mask estimation, improving rigid transformation. A PPR subnet based on multi-head attention mechanism refines the mask and registration iteratively. Extensive experiments on ModelNet40 and real-world datasets show our method's superiority over state-of-the-art methods.

articleTitle: A Novel Risk Analysis Method Based on LPFS and TOPSIS with Application in Railway Risk Analysis
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Computer Engineering (ICAICE)
abstract: Urban rail transit has become a focal point of attention in China, with safety emerging as a paramount concern. Effectively identifying and evaluating potential failures for condition-based maintenance in urban rail transit poses a substantial challenge. To this end, this study introduces an innovative linguistic Pythagorean fuzzy risk assessment approach for urban rail transit, amalgamating the best-worst method (BWM) and the technique for order of preference by similarity to ideal solution (TOPSIS) method under the failure mode and effects analysis framework. Firstly, 52 failure modes are identified based on expert knowledge, which are then assessed for four critical risk factors: occurrence, severity, cost, and detectability. Then, considering the inherent uncertainty and subjectivity in the risk assessment process, the linguistic Pythagorean fuzzy set (LPFS) is adopted to represent the experts judgments. Subsequently, the best-worst method (BWM) is integrated with LPFS to determine the weights of different risk factors. Next, the linguistic Pythagorean fuzzy TOPSIS method is introduced to evaluate and rank the failure modes. A practical case study on urban rail transit risk assessment is presented to illustrate the application and efficacy of the proposed method. Findings from the case study highlight the significance of driving facilities and auxiliary systems as pivotal components for ensuring urban rail transit safety. Notably, “bearing corroded, glued, worn, broken” emerges as the most significant failure mode. To validate the proposed method, sensitivity analysis and comparative analysis are conducted, reaffirming the robustness and reliability of the approach. The results of this study could provide insights and reference for improving the safety of urban rail transit systems.

articleTitle: A 3D Reconstruction Method Based on Adaptive Conditional Filtering Point Cloud Post-Processing
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Computer Engineering (ICAICE)
abstract: In the bridge crane lifting process, safety intelligent warning is needed in order to ensure the safety of the staff. Dynamic three-dimensional reconstruction of personnel and objects in the movement space of the operation process and subsequent collision detection can realize the function of safety warning. However, the images collected in the real environment usually have a complex background, coupled with the large size of the images collected by the industrial camera. The 3D reconstruction of the original images is time-consuming, affecting the real-time nature of the warning. In addition, the point clouds obtained from 3D reconstruction often contain noises, and the noises will have a great impact on the subsequent warning results. To solve these problems, a 3D reconstruction method based on adaptive conditional filtering point cloud post-processing is proposed in this paper. The region of person is detected by YOLOv8n object detection network. Then the region is cropped, and the SGBM (Semi-Global Block Matching) algorithm is performed only for the interested part, which reduces the computation time. The proposed adaptive conditional filtering point cloud post-processing algorithm converts parallax values from the SGBM algorithm into depth values, automatically updating depth thresholds to remove noises and complete three-dimensional reconstruction of personnel. The experimental results show that the proposed method's F-scores are kept above 0.9, while the processing time is within 10ms, with better filtering effect and real-time performance.

articleTitle: Rumor Detection Model Based on GAT and Multimodal Feature Codingmes
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Computer Engineering (ICAICE)
abstract: This paper proposes a social media rumor detection model that combines graph attention network (GAT) and multimodal feature coding. The model uses the multimodal content of social media news posts to encode, and on this basis, it also uses the graph attention network to construct the rumor propagation structure graph. At the same time, combined with the fact that rumor disseminators often publish social media rumors, it innovatively joins the multimodal feature mining of user historical posts, integrates the above work for common consideration, and carries out experiments on two commonly used data sets for rumor detection. The results show that the detection accuracy of the model is 7.72 and 2.14 percentage points higher than that of the commonly used rumor detection models Upfd and MFLAN, which proves the application potential of the multimodal fusion graph attention network rumor detection model in complex data environment.

articleTitle: A Model Based on RETE Algorithm for Generating Management and Control Measures for Key Personnel of Infectious Diseases
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Computer Engineering (ICAICE)
abstract: The prevention and control of infectious diseases require the determination of control measures for key personnel. However, in the past, manual research and judgement largely dictated the development of control measures. This approach was inefficient and resulted in a heavy workload, rendering standardization difficult. Furthermore, the traditional generation of control measures often proved unsustainable, curtailing progress towards utilizing an intelligent control system for key personnel. To alleviate the burden on frontline health workers and community disease control staff in implementing control measures, this thesis presents a model for generating intelligent control measures based on the RETE algorithm. Its purpose is to automate the control measures aimed at key individuals with infectious diseases. Research has demonstrated that utilizing the algorithm model approach can enhance work efficiency by obtaining control measures that adhere to high standards and accuracy. Subsequently, frontline staff can be relieved from repetitive tasks and focus on ensuring the quality control of the generated control measures and resultant accuracy of the output.

Author Keywords: Management of key personnel for infectious diseases

articleTitle: Big Data and Spatial Econometric Analysis of the Layout of Public Transport Stations in Wuhan and Zhengzhou
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Computer Engineering (ICAICE)
abstract: Along with the rapid development of urbanisation in China, the development pressure of urban public transport is increasing day by day. As an important infrastructure and component of the urban public transport system, the rationality of the spatial layout of bus stops is of great significance in improving the efficiency of the urban public transport system. Most of the studies on the layout of public transport are about how urban public transport can serve the urban residents in terms of living, socialising, commuting, consumption and recreation. This paper proposes that public transport facilities in cities (especially megacities) should also match the spatial distribution of residential areas, companies, catering services, attractions, and recreation. Different from the traditional methods of spatial statistical analyses, such as Moran index, nuclear density and so on. This paper adopts big data spatially econometrically analyse the layout of public transport stations in Wuhan and Zhengzhou from the perspective of multi-source data. The results of the case study show that compared with the obvious inner ring monocentric agglomeration layout of bus stops in Zhengzhou, the spatial layout of bus stops in Wuhan takes into account the clothing, food, housing, transportation and socio-economic development of the residents, and thus the spatial layout of bus stops in Wuhan seems to be more reasonable than that of Zhengzhou. The distribution of public bus stops in both cities is affected by the spatial distribution of public bus stops in its surrounding areas, which shows a significant spatial autocorrelation. This is consistent with the linear layout of public bus stops and the spatial concentration of its service objects.

articleTitle: Edge Cache and Computing Resource Migration Strategy for New Power Systems
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Computer Engineering (ICAICE)
abstract: With the development of power system with new energy as the main body, the characteristics of distribution are obvious, and the number of terminal equipment increases sharply. The scheduling and control of massive power loads are faced with problems such as high delay and insufficient computing efficiency. It is urgent to build an efficient communication network to effectively improve the operating efficiency and reliability of the power system. The existing work focuses on the integration of edge computing technology and power system, but does not consider the joint optimization of service cache and VM migration in edge network resource management. In order to solve these problems, a three-layer edge network architecture consisting of multiple devices, edge servers and power cloud centers is proposed by considering the factors of device transmission power, server computing and storage resources. Meanwhile, based on the task unloading model, service cache model and VM migration model, a resource allocation strategy combining service cache and VM migration is proposed to improve the system performance. Aiming at the coupling problem of service cache and VM migration joint optimization, the original problem was decoupled into two sub-problems for iterative solution, so as to achieve better resource allocation effect. The simulation results further prove that the proposed strategy has better performance and can obtain lower task processing delay compared with other schemes.

articleTitle: An Efficient Training Framework for Chinese Text Classification: Integrating Large Language Models and Reinforcement Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Computer Engineering (ICAICE)
abstract: This study proposes an efficient model training framework aimed at improving the performance of hierarchical classification of Chinese text in low-computation environments. By leveraging the generative capabilities of large language models for data annotation and augmentation, a high-quality dataset is constructed. Knowledge distillation techniques are applied to transfer knowledge from a complex teacher model to a lightweight student model, effectively reducing computational resources. Additionally, a reinforcement learning strategy is introduced to further optimize the student model, enabling it to surpass the teacher model in both accuracy and inference efficiency, providing a novel solution for natural language processing and other resource-constrained tasks.

articleTitle: DAG-AVAE: Combining GAN with Adversarial VAE to Enhance Causal Structure Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Computer Engineering (ICAICE)
abstract: The task of uncovering the causal structure underlying observed data has garnered significant interest and posed considerable challenges in recent years. While various methods, such as constraint-based and score-based approaches, have been validated, they often exhibit limitations in terms of time efficiency and flexibility. For instance, certain causal structure learning methods, like NOTEARS, attempt to transform a discrete search problem into a continuous optimization problem. However, these algorithms are typically constrained by the assumption of linear relationships among variables. In this paper, we introduce a novel framework, DAG-AVAE, which integrates variational autoencoders (VAE) with adversarial generative networks. This framework represents a fresh and complementary approach to learning the causal structure of observed data through continuous optimization methods. Notably, it accommodates the presence of nonlinear relationships between variables and leverages the output Kullback-Leibler (KL) divergence as a feedback mechanism. This allows for the automatic adjustment of parameters, such as hidden variables within the VAE objective, during the model training process. This innovation addresses the common issue of low reconstruction quality often associated with posterior collapse in VAE structures. Experimental results on both generated and benchmark datasets demonstrate that the directed acyclic graph (DAG) reconstructed by DAG-AVAE shows significant improvements in evaluation metrics, including structure Hamming distance and true positive rate, when compared to existing methods.

articleTitle: Hot Rolling Planning Based on Deep Reinforcement Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Computer Engineering (ICAICE)
abstract: Hot rolling plan plays a key role in improving the production efficiency and economic benefit of hot rolling. However, most of the steel enterprises still adopt the manual plan, which is often difficult to effectively match with the complicated and changing production environment, dynamic changes in order demand and multi-objective optimization challenges. A hot rolling plan method based on deep reinforcement learning is proposed to solve the above problem in this paper. A deep reinforcement learning model for the hot rolling is firstly established after analyzing the diversity of product specifications, the multiplicity of optimization objectives, and the uncertainty in the production process, etc. The hot rolling planning problem is described by a state space representation, which effectively captures the real-time information of the production site. The model is guided by its reward function to learn a planning strategy, which satisfies the production constraints and optimizes multiple objectives. The simulation results show that the proposed model has about over 70% correct rate for the hot rolling units that have been learned similar composition, which is superior to the plan method based on neural network model.

articleTitle: An Image Based Automatic Water Level Monitoring System
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Computer Engineering (ICAICE)
abstract: The water level is the most straightforward way to assess the condition of a water body, making it an essential indicator in the majority of water conservancy projects. At present, the water level monitoring in these projects is mainly realized by sensors, while research and applications of utilizing computer vision technology on water level monitoring are rare. The necessity for clear images of the water gauge in image-based water level monitoring is evident. However, environmental factors have the potential to interfere with the image capture process, thereby affecting the accuracy of the water level measurement. In some instances, this interference can even result in significant measurement errors. In this paper, an image-based water level monitoring system has been proposed. The system uses deep learning-based object detection technology to extract global and local features of water gauges, enabling it to accurately determine water levels in images despite the influence of complex weather conditions. The mean error of the proposed technology is 1.5 cm, which out performs state-of-the-art methods. Compared with the traditional sensor measurement system, the proposed system is simple to deploy and able to upgrade from existing monitoring systems. Consequently, it can provide an efficient and reliable water-level monitoring method for hydrological work.

articleTitle: Deep Attribute Graph Clustering Based on Dual Information Comparison Strategy
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Computer Engineering (ICAICE)
abstract: Existing deep attribute graph clustering is mainly divided into two stages: upstream graph representation learning and downstream clustering task. The upstream uses graph representation learning to obtain node embeddings, and the downstream uses the K-Means algorithm to cluster the node embeddings obtained by the upstream learning. Although graph representation learning based on contrastive learning has received great attention and achieved good results, there are still some problems. (1) How to use enhancement technology to generate an effective contrast view? (2) How to design an effective contrastive learning mechanism? (3) How to integrate upstream graph contrastive learning and downstream clustering tasks into an end-to-end framework? To solve the above problems, we propose a deep attribute graph clustering algorithm with a composite graph enhancement strategy and a dual information contrast strategy (DAGC-DICS). First, we obtain the augmented graph of the original attribute graph based on the composite graph enhancement strategy, and propose a dual information contrast strategy that can maximize the consistency of nodes in the contrast view. Finally, we design a multi-distribution self-supervision strategy to integrate graph representation learning and clustering tasks into an end-to-end framework. Extensive experiments are conducted on three benchmark datasets to verify the superiority and effectiveness of our method.

articleTitle: Q2Cypher: Converting Natural Language Questions to Cypher with Fine-Tuned Large Language Models
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Computer Engineering (ICAICE)
abstract: Knowledge Base Question Answering (KBQA) intends to obtain credible answers to natural language questions based on knowledge bases. Knowledge graphs, also known as graph databases, explicitly present a large amount of factual knowledge and the associations among them. Neo4j, one of the most popular graph databases, uses the Cypher Query Language (CQL) for efficient querying. Due to its complexity, converting natural language questions into CQL, i.e., Text-to-CQL, is in demand, but the performance is undesirable for existing models. To address the issue, we propose Q2Cypher, a Text-to-CQL framework that is able to generate corresponding CQL based on natural language questions by fine-tuning open-source large language models (LLMs). Q2Cypher employs an unsupervised joint retrieval method to further align entity and relation names in the CQL, thus improving generation from the models more directly. We conduct experiments on open-source LLMs such as ChatGLM2, Baichuan2 and Llama-2, using different fine-tuning methods such as LoRA, Freeze and QLoRA for comparison. The experimental results demonstrate that Q2Cypher is effective and achieves better performance than existing methods on the SpCQL dataset.

articleTitle: Community-Diversified Influence Maximization Based on Community-Aware Closeness
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Computer Engineering (ICAICE)
abstract: The issue of influence maximization (IM) has been demonstrated to be highly significant across various applications. Yet, consideration for diversified community during the influence maximization remains scarce. Diversified community can effectively mitigate the impact of unforeseen risks on information spread. By assessing the influence of individual nodes within a network, it becomes feasible to identify seed nodes that optimize overall network influence. In recent years, scholars have integrated community concepts with centrality measures, introducing community-aware centrality metrics that surpass classical centrality in terms of precision. Building on this advancement, we introduce an innovative metric, Community-aware Closeness (CAC), designed to gauge the dissemination potential of nodes. Employing CAC for node ranking, we devise a greedy algorithm to select a set of <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$k$</tex> seed nodes aimed at amplifying community-diversified influence. We benchmarked CAC against alternative community-aware centrality indicators using Kendall's Tau correlation coefficient, revealing our method's superior accuracy and broader applicability across diverse networks. Furthermore, we assessed the ultimate activation extent and community-diversified performance relative to competing greedy strategies within real-world networks modeled via the IC model, originating from <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$k$</tex> seed nodes. Our findings affirm that the centrality-based approach we propose yields enhanced outcomes.

articleTitle: Construction Waste Detection Based on Improved YOLOv8
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Computer Engineering (ICAICE)
abstract: We present an enhanced YOLOv8 algorithm to address accuracy limitations in construction waste detection. Our improvements include integrating adaptive kernel convolution (AKConv) with the C2f module in the backbone network, implementing CARAFE upsampling in the neck region, and incorporating an inverted residual block attention mechanism (iRMB). Additionally, we optimize the loss function using MPDIoU, which streamlines computation while maintaining comprehensive evaluation metrics. Experimental results demonstrate superior performance, achieving 77.1% mAP50 and 61.7% mAP50-95, surpassing YOLOv8n by 1.2% and 1.4% respectively. These improvements validate our algorithm's effectiveness in construction waste detection.

articleTitle: A Information Extraction Method for Electromechanical Equipment Fault Diagnosis Knowledge Graphs Based on Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Computer Engineering (ICAICE)
abstract: In the process of fault diagnosis for electromechanical equipment, a significant amount of equipment-related record information remains underutilized, leading to inefficiencies in fault reasoning and diagnosis. To address this issue, we propose a method for electromechanical equipment information extraction based on deep learning and knowledge graphs. This method extracts critical information from expert knowledge, equipment operational status, and maintenance logs to construct a knowledge graph suitable for fault diagnosis of electromechanical equipment. For information extraction, we propose an Enhanced BERT-BiLSTM-CRF model (EBBC-DAM-PATM), which enhances the traditional BERT-BiLSTM-CRF (BBC) deep neural network by introducing a Data Augmentation Module (DAM) and Projection Gradient Descent Adversarial Training Module (PATM). In the named entity recognition task for electromechanical equipment, this model demonstrates superior recall and F2 scores compared to the traditional BERT-BiLSTM-CRF model, along with better stability. Ultimately, we validated the effectiveness of this information extraction method and constructed a specialized knowledge graph for fault diagnosis of electromechanical equipment.

articleTitle: Road Object Detection Algorithm Based on Improved YOLOv8n Model
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Computer Engineering (ICAICE)
abstract: A road object detection algorithm based on an improved YOLOv8n is proposed to solve the problems of low detection accuracy, high difficulty, large computational volume and very easy to misdetection and omission in the current field of road target recognition. Firstly, introducing a CA mechanism into the backbone layer of the YOLOv8n,which can reinforce the acquisition of models feature capacity for tiny targets, achieve more accurate localization of target detection positions, improve network recognition performance, and especially strengthen robustness in complex backgrounds; Secondly, the deformable convolutional DCNv2 module in the Backbone layer is introduced and fused with it, and the new module has the ability to change the spatial distribution and influence of the samples, which improves the variability of the model. Thirdly, the path aggregation network PANet is substituted by the weighted BiFPN in the neck, and add the unparameterized attention module SimAM after each C2f module to enhance the models capacity for feature fusion, so as to exchange a small amount of computational cost for a larger model benefit; and finally, Inner-CIoU is quoted to substituted for the original CIoU to accelerate the sample regression and improve the network generalization ability. The results show that the enhanced YOLOv8n algorithm attains the precision is 90.96%, a recall ratio is 89.25%, and the mean average precision is 92.37%, which surpasses other mainstream detection algorithms. The conclusions demonstrate that the model has a high recognition accuracy and detection speed, and it has a higher application value for the recognition of road targets, and provides a higher application value for transportation safety. value for road target recognition, which provides a more reliable technical guarantee for transportation safety.

articleTitle: Research on Fault Diagnosis Algorithm for Unmanned Surface Vehicle Based on Channel Pruning Lightweight Network
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Computer Engineering (ICAICE)
abstract: The continuous advancement of unmanned surface vessels (USVs) technology has led to its increasingly widespread adoption in marine surveillance, security patrols, and related applications. USVs must conduct real-time fault diagnosis during mission execution to ensure navigational safety. USVs typically have limited computational capabilities. Traditional fault diagnosis methods require substantial computational resources and struggle to meet real-time requirements, posing a significant challenge for computationally constrained USVs. Therefore, developing an efficient, accurate, and lightweight fault diagnosis model is crucial for ensuring the safe operation of unmanned surface vessels. To address this issue, we propose a lightweight network fault diagnosis method for USVs based on channel pruning. By grouping the coupled parameters of adjacent layers in the fault diagnosis network and evaluating the importance of each group, subsequently, the model is pruned by eliminating channels with the least significance. This makes it more suitable for real-time monitoring and fault diagnosis of the operational status of USVs. The efficacy of the method proposed in this study was validated using a maritime unmanned surface vessel (USV) fault diagnosis experimental platform. The results indicate that the lightweight fault diagnosis model for unmanned surface vehicles, based on channel pruning, reduces both parameter count and computational load by 34% compared to the original model, while only decreasing the fault diagnosis accuracy by 0.4%. This indicates that the channel pruning method proposed in this paper significantly enhances computational efficiency while maintaining high diagnostic accuracy for USVs. The method allows for rapid and effective fault diagnosis of USVs.

articleTitle: Self-Supervised Learning Recommendation with Enhanced Long-Tail Nodes
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Computer Engineering (ICAICE)
